About Us

At Rapid Pioneers, we provide opportunities to work with leading innovative technology companies worldwide, offering stable employment, competitive compensation, career growth, and access to a community of 25,000+ like-minded marketing professionals.

About the Company

You will be joining a fast-growing wellness and massage company that currently operates in five German cities and is expanding to seven. The company is known for a high-quality, above-and-beyond approach to customer service, and its People team is scaling hiring quickly to keep pace with that growth. This hire sits at the very start of the recruitment funnel, where speed and a great first impression make all the difference.

The Role

As a Junior Recruiter, you will be the first voice candidates hear from the company. You will call new applicants quickly, introduce the opportunity with energy and confidence, and run short screening calls so the strongest people move forward without delay.

This is an entry point into recruiting, and no previous recruiting experience is needed. You’ll work closely with the Head of People, splitting your time between the Berlin office and home. It’s ideal for someone who loves talking to people, moves fast, and wants to learn recruiting from the ground up.

Key Responsibilities

  • Call new applicants within 24 hours to keep interest high

  • Give a clear, friendly phone introduction to the company and the role

  • Run short screening calls and pass qualified candidates to the next stage

  • Handle a high volume of outbound calls and follow-ups so good candidates never go cold

  • Cover evening and weekend shifts to keep response times fast

  • Keep candidate information accurate and up to date in Personio

  • Share feedback with the Head of People to improve call scripts and results

Ideal Candidate

  • Fluent German (essential)

  • Fluent spoken and written English (essential)

  • Based in Berlin with the right to work in Germany, able to work hybrid from the office

  • Available for evenings and weekends as a regular part of the schedule

  • Some experience in a people-facing role such as sales, customer service, hospitality, retail or call centre work

  • Confident on the phone and quick to build rapport with all kinds of people

  • Resilient and upbeat, staying motivated across high call volumes and the occasional “not interested”

  • Organised and reliable, keeping track of many conversations without letting anything slip

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in recruiting or talent acquisition

  • Experience with Personio or a similar HR system or CRM

Tools & Stack

Personio, phone and video calling tools

Join Our Team

Be part of a collaborative, innovative environment where your technical skills and product instincts can make a real impact. We offer competitive compensation, professional development opportunities, and a supportive work culture. Apply now and take the next step in your career.

At Rapid Pioneers, our mission is to bridge the gap between leading global tech companies and amazing global talent. We believe everyone deserves equal access to opportunities, regardless of the country they happen to be born in.

data.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Build the machine that builds the machine. Join TechOps at the forefront of advanced manufacturing, we’re building the production system that will enable commercial fusion. The Production lines, tooling, and processes are being developed from the ground up; you'll create the ways of working, not inherit them.

  • Work at the frontier of manufacturing technology. Bring your creativity to evaluate, qualify, and deploy processes with no industry playbook, every component you build and every process you shape goes directly into the core of the stellarator magnet technology.

  • Do work that matters, and see it grow. The hardware you build is the product and your career grows with it, from prototyping and process development through quality and industrialization, alongside exceptional colleagues from around the world.

  • Make an impact you can point to. In a small, fast-moving team, your calls on equipment, quality, and process directly shape how a world-class deep-tech company produces superconducting magnets with results visible on the shop floor, not buried in a slidedeck.

YOUR IMPACT

You keep Alpha's cost and schedule baselines honest against each other. Without a credible risk register and change process, changes slip into the program outside any controlled path, the IMS and cost forecast quietly drift apart, and a gate review surprises leadership with numbers nobody signed off on. Your job is to prevent that by making risk and change management a live, trusted function from the earliest stage of delivery, rather than something bolted on once problems have compounded.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Establish and maintain the Alpha risk register across infrastructure, manufacturing and machine workstreams, facilitating structured risk identification, assessment and assignment of mitigation owners

  • Own the change control process end to end, from intake and schedule, cost and technical impact assessment through to approval routing and the change log, working closely with the Cost Controller and Programme Schedule Manager so all baselines reflect the same accepted changes

  • Prepare risk-adjusted inputs for release gate decisions, including quantified schedule and cost exposure and mitigation status

  • Run regular risk reviews with workstream owners and escalate emerging risks early, before they reach senior leadership as surprises

  • Build risk and change governance standards that scale as Alpha and Stellaris grow in parallel, with different partners and delivery models

  • Support the PMO's wider reporting cadence alongside the PMO Analyst/Coordinator


WHO YOU ARE

  • Experienced in risk and change management on major capital programs in energy, industrial, research infrastructure or similarly complex multi-discipline settings

  • Able to build a risk and change framework from scratch, not just administer an inherited one; you know what good governance looks like before it exists

  • Confident holding the line on change discipline with internal engineers and external partners who have their own priorities, combining analytical rigor with the communication skills to make it stick

  • Comfortable working with high autonomy while program structure is still being built

  • Fluent in English; German is a strong advantage given the contractor and regulatory landscape

  • Familiar with AI tools and digital ways of working, and quick to adapt in a lean, fast-paced environment

    INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

We're looking for an ambitious PM ready to build Nelly's Growth function from scratch - owning the full journey from sign-up to habit across our software, AI, and fintech surfaces, with direct impact on NRR. If you want real ownership and zero hand-holding, this is it.

 

About Nelly

We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people.

Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality.

What sets us apart: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI is an essential part of how we work at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable.

Joining us, you will:

  • Translate Nelly's company vision into specific, prioritized bets across acquisition, activation, and monetisation, informed by data, experimentation, and customer behavior

  • Own the end-to-end user journey: from partial sign-up through setup, first value, and habit formation - across Nelly's software, AI, and fintech products, and continuously sharpen each stage

  • Build platform-level growth capabilities that compound across surfaces , not features that live in one place

  • Design and run a rigorous experimentation and measurement program. Form hypotheses, define metrics, ship A/B tests at high velocity, learn fast, and ship what moves the numbers

  • Collaborate deeply with Design, Engineering, Marketing, and Product Leadership on both strategy and execution

  • Inform pricing, packaging, and self-serve strategy in partnership with GTM and finance leadership - including how we package across software, AI, and fintech to drive expansion (vertical & geo)

What you'll bring:

Note: If you don't meet all the criteria, we still encourage you to apply and make the case for why you'd be a great fit. If you're exceptional talent, we're happy to adapt.

  • Shipped exceptional B2B/prosumer growth products in high-velocity environments - you care deeply about user outcomes and winning with the product

  • 3+ years in product management with hands-on PLG (and ideally PLS) experience: you've built and owned elaborated growth motions on complex B2B workflow products

  • High agency and high learning velocity: you run a high volume of hypothesis-driven bets, move fast in ambiguity, say "no" when needed, and are comfortable building from zero

  • Strong analytical skills and data mindset around A/B testing, optimization, and defining growth metrics

  • Strong data mindset: you create data acquisition and evaluation strategies, track product and agent metrics (utilization rates, precision & recall), understand online vs. offline eval trade-offs, and use insights to drive better customer outcomes

  • Passion for AI technology and its potential to reshape product-led growth

  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success

Even better if you have:

  • German or Italian proficiency - you can discuss real work with dentists, ZFAs/ZMVs, and billing partners

  • Experience growing products for SMB customers in less-digital European verticals (healthcare, construction, legal, architecture, or similar) where adoption is hard-won and not a given

  • Experience with self-serve, freemium, or PQL-driven growth motions

  • Experience with high-growth SaaS products using usage or outcome-based pricing, where you owned strategies to drive net revenue retention (NRR) growth

What we offer:

  • The people you get to work with. You will work alongside the brightest minds we could find, on hard problems, as a team. We take on challenges together and we never forget to have fun doing it.

  • Room to grow faster than almost anywhere else. New challenges, more scope, real ownership from day one. We trust you to own it and to speak up when something is wrong. Just do not expect to stand still.

  • A yearly learning and development budget, plus the coaching, feedback and internal knowledge that actually move you forward. Real investment in your learning.

  • A front row seat while we build something big. We are building the financial operating system for European healthcare, with AI woven into how we build, sell and support. Real scope, real impact.

  • Deutschlandticket or Swapfiets membership.

  • Urban Sports Club membership.

  • Flexible working hours and a hybrid setup and up to 4 weeks of workation.

  • A dog friendly office.

We welcome applications from people of all genders and backgrounds, regardless of origin or age. If you're convinced you're the right fit for this role - even if your CV doesn't match the requirements 100% - tell us why.

data.description:
At idealo, we've built a strong SEO foundation. Now, we're looking to take the next step. As AI-powered search experiences such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and Gemini increasingly influence how people research products and make purchasing decisions, we want to ensure idealo becomes a trusted and frequently cited source within these new shopping journeys.

As our GEO Manager, you'll take ownership of developing Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) as an additional growth discipline alongside our established SEO activities. Combining your technical SEO expertise with hands-on experience in AI search optimization, you'll develop our GEO strategy, establish meaningful visibility monitoring, and drive experimentation to understand what makes content and data discoverable, relevant, and citable by generative AI systems.

You'll work closely with our SEO team and collaborate across Product, Engineering, Content, Brand, and Communications to turn emerging opportunities into scalable solutions.

About your new role

  • GEO Strategy & Development: You develop and drive idealo's GEO strategy and experimentation roadmap, building on our existing SEO foundation. You identify opportunities across generative search platforms and AI-assisted shopping journeys, translating emerging developments into actionable initiatives aligned with our broader SEO and business objectives.

  • AI Visibility & Performance Monitoring: You establish and continuously improve a GEO monitoring framework covering platforms such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews. You define relevant KPIs, including mention and citation rates, share of voice, sentiment, and positioning within AI-generated answers, and develop dashboards that make performance and progress transparent to different stakeholders.

  • Technical GEO Optimization: You leverage your technical SEO expertise to improve how generative AI systems discover, interpret, and reference idealo's content. This includes optimizing structured data (Schema.org), semantic relationships, product and offer information, and identifying technical opportunities to strengthen our visibility and accessibility across AI-powered search experiences.

  • Experimentation & Competitive Analysis: You design, implement, and evaluate GEO experiments, analyze idealo's visibility against relevant competitors, and translate findings into concrete optimization measures. You continuously assess emerging GEO tools, methodologies, and platform capabilities to improve our approach.

  • AI Shopping & Content Optimization: You explore how idealo's product, pricing, and offer data can become a valuable information source for AI agents and agentic commerce. Together with Content Marketing, you assess existing content and develop answer-focused, well-structured formats that strengthen relevance, authority, and citation potential.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing: You connect technical SEO and GEO requirements with Product and Engineering initiatives and collaborate with Brand and Communications/PR on authority-building and digital PR opportunities. You actively share your expertise, communicate findings to stakeholders, and contribute insights from the evolving AI search landscape to idealo's long-term SEO strategy.


Skills & Requirements

  • 3-5 years of hands-on SEO experience, with a clear focus on technical SEO. 

  • Strong technical SEO fundamentals: site architecture, crawlability, indexing, Core Web Vitals, JavaScript SEO, and experience running full technical audits. 

  • Practical understanding of how generative search systems retrieve, summarize, and cite content.

  • Experience with data analysis, KPI definition, and translating data into recommendations. 

  • Hands-on proficiency with core SEO tools (Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, Screaming Frog or similar crawler). 

  • Familiarity with structured data, semantic models, and entity-based SEO. 

  • Experience with GEO/AI visibility tools (e.g., Profound, AirOps, Rankscale, Peec AI, Otterly). 

  • Strong AI mindset: willing to test new GEO tools and methods and share learnings with the team. 

  • Excellent communication skills, able to present technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Content, Brand, and Communications/PR. 

  • Experience in e-commerce, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL or reporting automation with tools such as n8n are a plus.

At idealo you can expect

  • You want to further your education? We take your personal development goals seriously and, in addition to our idealo Learning Hub, eLearning offerings (e.g., Udemy), coaching & mediation, we also offer you the opportunity to benefit individually from additional learning and development budget.

  • And what about the office? Our office in the heart of Berlin offers free organic breakfast, excellent free lunch (vegan and vegetarian), as well as free coffee, lemonades and after-work beer, in addition to the "standard foosball". It also has a fabulous rooftop terrace with view of the whole of berlin where you can network with colleagues from our group of companies.

  • In need of additional support in any areas of your life? We offer free counseling and support in all areas of life (professional, private, family, health, etc.) in cooperation with the pme-Familienservice.

  • You want full flexibility on your way to work and beyond? No problem with a job bike or Deutschlandticket - and it's environmentally friendly, too!

  • Want to keep yourself fit? We offer many different fitness and sports options, such as an Urban Sports or Gympass membership, to suit your personal needs.

  • And what else is there? Of course, success must be celebrated! In addition to team events, you can also expect big company events and other moments of organized connection with others in the company and your team throughout the year!

Du möchtest in einer der führenden Steuerkanzleien in Düsseldorf tätig sein und die Kanzlei bei Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und stabilen IT-Prozessen unterstützen?

Wir suchen Wirtschaftsinformatiker/in (Vollzeit) (m/w/d), die unser Team in Prozessaufnahme, Systemeinführung, Schnittstellenanbindung und im IT-Betrieb zuverlässig unterstützen. Während der Einarbeitung lernst du unsere digitale Arbeitsweise, das Dokumenten- und Fristenmanagement sowie unsere Automatisierungs- und DATEV-Systeme kennen.

Deine täglichen Aufgaben:

  • Betreuung der eingesetzten SaaS-Anwendungen (User-/Lizenzverwaltung, Konfiguration, Berechtigungen)

  • Einrichtung, Installation und Konfiguration von Standard-Software

  • Dokumentation und Konzeption digitaler Geschäftsprozesse (SOPs, Checklisten)

  • Planung und Einführung neuer Software- und IT-Lösungen

  • Verbinden von Standardlösungen über Schnittstellen

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Automationen für wiederkehrende Aufgaben (z. B. Zapier/Mirror/ähnliche Tools)

  • Anwenderschulung und -betreuung (First/Second Level), Erstellung von Leitfäden

  • Fehleranalyse und Störungsbeseitigung über Ticketsystem

  • DATEV-Support-Themen in Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen und Dienstleistern

Zusätzliche Aufgaben (je nach Erfahrung)

  • System- und Rechteverwaltung, Basis-Administration (Benutzer, Endgeräte)

  • Mitarbeit an IT-Sicherheits- und Compliance-Standards (Richtlinien, Backups)

  • Auswahl und Steuerung externer Dienstleister; Lizenz- und Asset-Management

  • Ausbau von Low-Code/No-Code-Automationen

  • Prozessoptimierung und Projektmanagement in enger Abstimmung mit Fachabteilungen

Vorteile, auf die du dich freuen kannst:

  • Klare Strukturen und Prozesse:
    Bei uns findest du eine eindeutige Aufgabenverteilung, standardisierte Abläufe und dokumentierte Prozesse. Du erhältst praxisbewährtes Fachwissen und kannst dich auf eine planbare Einarbeitung verlassen. Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten sind klar definiert und nachvollziehbar. 

  • Attraktive Vergütung:
    Du erhältst von Beginn an ein überdurchschnittliches, festes Gehalt. Zusätzlich gibt es je nach Stelle transparente und messbare Bonusregelungen für besonders gute Leistungen.

  • Professionelle Mandate:
    Du arbeitest in einer der führenden Kanzleien in Düsseldorf und hilfst bei der Betreuung von renommierten Mandanten. Du arbeitest mit strukturierten und professionellen Mandanten aus dem Mittelstand und aus etablierten Branchen. Dadurch hast du ein stabiles, planbares Umfeld in deiner täglichen Arbeit.

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz
    Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Wir haben nur unbefristete Arbeitsverträge in Vollzeit. Durch unser kontinuierliches Wachstum und die stabile Auftragslage bieten wir dir eine langfristige Perspektive mit hoher Arbeitsplatzsicherheit.

  • Hochmodernes Büro:
    Du arbeitest bei uns in einem voll verglasten Büro mit atemberaubender Aussicht über Düsseldorf und mit den neuesten Geräten. Unser Büro ist klar strukturiert, technisch auf dem neuesten Stand und bietet dir eine ruhige, professionelle Arbeitsatmosphäre mit Blick über den Rhein und Medienhafen.

  • Digitale Arbeitswelt:
    Wir arbeiten vollständig digital, sind von DATEV als Digitale Kanzlei ausgezeichnet und nutzen automatisierte Prozesse, damit du dich auf deine Kernaufgaben konzentrieren kannst. Wir sind eine innovative Kanzlei im Bereich Digitalisierung.

Eckdaten zur Stelle:

  • Gehalt: 42.000 - 54.000 Euro (brutto) Jahresgehalt

  • Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: vorhanden

  • Einarbeitungsphase: in der Regel 2–4 Monate


  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung (z. B. IT-Systemkaufmann/-frau, Informatikkaufmann/-frau) oder Studium (Wirtschaftsinformatik o. ä.)

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Support, IT-Administration oder Software-Implementierung

  • Erfahrung mit Integrations-/Automation-Tools (z. B. Zapier, Mirror/Make o. ä.) und Routine im DATEV-Umfeld

  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office; Erstellung/Pflege von Formularen und Dokumenten

  • Sehr gute Ausdrucksform in Wort und Schrift; hohe Verlässlichkeit und Diskretion

  • Strukturierte, vorausschauende und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise; souverän in dynamischen Situationen

  • Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit und serviceorientiertes Auftreten

Benefits:

Deine Aufgaben:

• Gesamtverantwortung: Du verantwortest das Rechnungswesen der Gesellschaften in Deutschland und Österreich und setzt es operativ um – ordnungsgemäß nach HGB, GoBD und Steuerrecht.

• Organisation & Dienstleister: Du steuerst externe Partner (Steuerberatung, Payroll), legst Zuständigkeiten und Freigaberegelungen fest und baust das Accounting für den geplanten Markteintritt in der Schweiz auf.

OSS), betriebliche Steuererklärungen mit der Steuerberatung, Betriebsprüfungen und Kassennachschauen, Kassen-Compliance (KassenSichV/TSE, RKSV) und statistische Meldungen (z. B. Intrastat). • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Rechnungswesen, davon idealerweise einige Jahre in verantwortlicher Rolle

• Sicherer Umgang mit HGB, GoBD und deutschem Steuerrecht; Kenntnisse in UGB und österreichischem Steuerrecht sind ein Plus

• Erfahrung im Filial- bzw. Retailgeschäft (POS, Kasse, Inventuren) und mit Kassen-Compliance

• Erfahrung im Reporting an eine internationale Muttergesellschaft und mit Intercompany-Themen

• Routine in der Zusammenarbeit mit Steuerberatung und Wirtschaftsprüfung

• Erfahrung mit Payroll (DE/AT) ist ein Plus

• Hands-on-Mentalität, Struktur und Lust, Prozesse und ein IKS aufzubauen

• Affinität für digitale Tools und ERP-Systeme [ e.g. Navision]

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Was wir bieten

• Eine Schlüsselrolle mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum: Du baust Strukturen, Prozesse und das IKS mit auf

• Die Chance, weitere Expansionen zu begleiten

• Bei Interesse und passender Erfahrung kannst du perspektivisch auch die Payroll-Schnittstelle übernehmen

• Kurze Entscheidungswege und enge Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung und Group Finance in Kopenhagen

• Ein internationales Umfeld mit einer Premiummarke

• Personalrabatt auf unsere Produkte

Klingt das nach dir ?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf, Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestmöglichem Eintrittstermin.

Inclusion & Diversity commitment

Wir bei Simplyright helfen unseren Kunden dabei, ihr Recht schnell und unkompliziert durchzusetzen.   • Du bearbeitest Kundenanliegen und administrative Vorgänge im Innendienst.

In den ersten Monaten wirst du dich intensiv in unsere Abläufe im Backoffice einarbeiten, Kundenakten eigenständig bearbeiten und den direkten Kontakt zu unseren Mandanten übernehmen. Vergütung und Benefits

Für diese Position bieten wir ein Gehalt im Rahmen von EUR 2,500–2,800 per month. Du profitierst von flexiblem Homeoffice und kannst komplett remote arbeiten. Zudem unterstützen wir dich mit bezahlten Krankheitstagen und zusätzlichen Urlaubstagen.

data.description:
Der Plan steht, jetzt fehlst du: Bring unsere Software von Legacy-PHP auf Symfony und React.

Auf einen Blick

  • Stack: PHP 8.1 (Legacy) → Symfony · jQuery/Vanilla-JS → React · MySQL/MariaDB, SingleStore · Git, CI/CD

  • Gehalt: 52.000–62.000 € brutto/Jahr, für außergewöhnliche Profile auch mehr · unbefristet, Vollzeit

  • Arbeitsmodell: hybrid, 3 Tage Büro / 2 Tage remote

  • Standort: Berlin

  • Produkt: Eine Software für Termin- und Vorgangsmanagement in der öffentlichen Verwaltung

  • Start: so bald wie möglich oder nach Vereinbarung

Die Rolle

Das Kernprodukt unserer Kunden ist über viele Jahre gewachsen, und das sieht man dem Code an. Das Backend läuft auf PHP 8.1 ohne Framework. Im Frontend stehen jQuery und Vanilla-JS neben React, und automatisierte Tests gibt es bisher wenige.

Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität.

Du triffst eigenständig technische Entscheidungen, bringst dich in Architektur- und Modernisierungsfragen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Codequalität mit jedem Release besser wird. Dabei bleibt das Produkt im Einsatz: Wartung, Support und neue Features laufen parallel zur Modernisierung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Legacy-Module bei laufendem Betrieb schrittweise durch Symfony-Services und React-Oberflächen ersetzen

  • Fullstack-Features von der Datenbank bis zum Frontend entwickeln, teils auch als kundenspezifische Erweiterungen

  • Bestehenden Legacy-Code pflegen, debuggen und weiterentwickeln

  • Code-Reviews durchführen und die Testabdeckung ausbauen

  • Mit Entwicklungsleitung und Geschäftsführung abstimmen, welche Bereiche als Nächstes modernisiert werden

  • Zwei Auszubildende im letzten Ausbildungsabschnitt fachlich begleiten (ohne disziplinarische Führung)

  • Gelegentlich an Kundenterminen teilnehmen, etwa alle 3–4 Wochen

Nach 6 Monaten …

… setzt du Features eigenständig um, hast spürbar zur Modernisierung beigetragen, die Codequalität verbessert und bist für die Auszubildenden eine feste Ansprechperson.

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze)

  • PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID

  • Symfony: nachweisbare Praxiserfahrung mit dem Framework

  • Legacy-Code: Du gehst sicher mit gewachsenen Codebasen um. Du refaktorierst, debuggst und entwickelst weiter, ohne alles neu zu schreiben.

  • JavaScript/React: solide Erfahrung im Frontend, jQuery schreckt dich nicht ab

  • Datenbanken: relationale Datenbanken wie MySQL/MariaDB oder SingleStore und sicherer Umgang mit SQL

  • Tooling: Git und Arbeit mit CI/CD

  • Sprache: Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch mindestens B1

  • Arbeitsweise: eigenständig, strukturiert, proaktiv und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch

  • Persönlich: Du kommunizierst verlässlich, arbeitest gern im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung, hast keine Angst vor schwierigen Codestellen und gibst dein Wissen gern weiter.

  • Abschluss: Ausbildung oder FH-Abschluss zählen genauso viel wie ein Uni-Studium. Entscheidend ist deine Praxiserfahrung.

Pluspunkte: REST/API-Design und Schnittstellenentwicklung, automatisiertes Testing (PHPUnit, Jest), Docker, Deployment-Pipelines und Cloud, Software-Architektur und Design-Patterns, produktiver Einsatz von KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder Codex. Erfahrung mit Software für den öffentlichen Sektor ist nicht nötig.

Dein Team

Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen: ein Developer Lead, ein Geschäftsführer und Projektmanager, der selbst aktiv mitentwickelt, ein externer Entwickler und zwei Auszubildende. Ihr stimmt euch täglich ab. Die Entwicklungsleitung und die Geschäftsführung übernehmen dein Onboarding persönlich.

Was wir bieten

  • Ein sinnstiftendes Produkt, das täglich in Bürgerämtern genutzt wird, in einem krisensicheren Markt

  • Echter Einfluss auf technische Entscheidungen und eine Modernisierung mit klarem Ziel

  • 30 Urlaubstage

  • Gleitzeit mit Kernzeit ab 10 Uhr, 2 Remote-Tage pro Woche

  • Weiterbildung während der Arbeitszeit, Udemy-Kurse; eigene Vorschläge sind willkommen

  • Claude-Lizenz, offen für weitere Tools

  • Hardware: Lenovo ThinkPad, offen für Vorschläge

  • UrbanSportsClub und JobRad

  • Gute Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr

So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess

  • Kennenlerngespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team

  • Technisches Interview mit Live-Projektarbeit mit dem Developer Lead und der Geschäftsführung

  • Teamgespräch vor Ort

  • Angebot

Über das Unternehmen

Unser Kunde entwickelt seit über 25 Jahren Software für die öffentliche Verwaltung. Städte wie Berlin, München, Bonn und Dessau setzen seit Jahrzehnten auf die Lösungen des Unternehmens.

Du willst ein bewährtes Produkt fit für die Zukunft machen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

data.description:
At idealo, we've built a strong SEO foundation. Now, we're looking to take the next step. As AI-powered search experiences such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and Gemini increasingly influence how people research products and make purchasing decisions, we want to ensure idealo becomes a trusted and frequently cited source within these new shopping journeys.

As our GEO Manager, you'll take ownership of developing Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) as an additional growth discipline alongside our established SEO activities. Combining your technical SEO expertise with hands-on experience in AI search optimization, you'll develop our GEO strategy, establish meaningful visibility monitoring, and drive experimentation to understand what makes content and data discoverable, relevant, and citable by generative AI systems.

You'll work closely with our SEO team and collaborate across Product, Engineering, Content, Brand, and Communications to turn emerging opportunities into scalable solutions.

About your new role

  • GEO Strategy & Development: You develop and drive idealo's GEO strategy and experimentation roadmap, building on our existing SEO foundation. You identify opportunities across generative search platforms and AI-assisted shopping journeys, translating emerging developments into actionable initiatives aligned with our broader SEO and business objectives.

  • AI Visibility & Performance Monitoring: You establish and continuously improve a GEO monitoring framework covering platforms such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews. You define relevant KPIs, including mention and citation rates, share of voice, sentiment, and positioning within AI-generated answers, and develop dashboards that make performance and progress transparent to different stakeholders.

  • Technical GEO Optimization: You leverage your technical SEO expertise to improve how generative AI systems discover, interpret, and reference idealo's content. This includes optimizing structured data (Schema.org), semantic relationships, product and offer information, and identifying technical opportunities to strengthen our visibility and accessibility across AI-powered search experiences.

  • Experimentation & Competitive Analysis: You design, implement, and evaluate GEO experiments, analyze idealo's visibility against relevant competitors, and translate findings into concrete optimization measures. You continuously assess emerging GEO tools, methodologies, and platform capabilities to improve our approach.

  • AI Shopping & Content Optimization: You explore how idealo's product, pricing, and offer data can become a valuable information source for AI agents and agentic commerce. Together with Content Marketing, you assess existing content and develop answer-focused, well-structured formats that strengthen relevance, authority, and citation potential.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing: You connect technical SEO and GEO requirements with Product and Engineering initiatives and collaborate with Brand and Communications/PR on authority-building and digital PR opportunities. You actively share your expertise, communicate findings to stakeholders, and contribute insights from the evolving AI search landscape to idealo's long-term SEO strategy.



Skills & Requirements

  • 3-5 years of hands-on SEO experience, with a clear focus on technical SEO. 

  • Strong technical SEO fundamentals: site architecture, crawlability, indexing, Core Web Vitals, JavaScript SEO, and experience running full technical audits. 

  • Practical understanding of how generative search systems retrieve, summarize, and cite content.

  • Experience with data analysis, KPI definition, and translating data into recommendations. 

  • Hands-on proficiency with core SEO tools (Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, Screaming Frog or similar crawler). 

  • Familiarity with structured data, semantic models, and entity-based SEO. 

  • Experience with GEO/AI visibility tools (e.g., Profound, AirOps, Rankscale, Peec AI, Otterly). 

  • Strong AI mindset: willing to test new GEO tools and methods and share learnings with the team. 

  • Excellent communication skills, able to present technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Content, Brand, and Communications/PR. 

  • Experience in e-commerce, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL or reporting automation with tools such as n8n are a plus.

At idealo you can expect

  • You want to further your education? We take your personal development goals seriously and, in addition to our idealo Learning Hub, eLearning offerings (e.g., Udemy), coaching & mediation, we also offer you the opportunity to benefit individually from additional learning and development budget.

  • And what about the office? Our office in the heart of Berlin offers free organic breakfast, excellent free lunch (vegan and vegetarian), as well as free coffee, lemonades and after-work beer, in addition to the "standard foosball". It also has a fabulous rooftop terrace with view of the whole of berlin where you can network with colleagues from our group of companies.

  • In need of additional support in any areas of your life? We offer free counseling and support in all areas of life (professional, private, family, health, etc.) in cooperation with the pme-Familienservice.

  • You want full flexibility on your way to work and beyond? No problem with a job bike or Deutschlandticket - and it's environmentally friendly, too!

  • Want to keep yourself fit? We offer many different fitness and sports options, such as an Urban Sports or Gympass membership, to suit your personal needs.

  • And what else is there? Of course, success must be celebrated! In addition to team events, you can also expect big company events and other moments of organized connection with others in the company and your team throughout the year!

Wir verwalten über 70.000 Einheiten in ganz Deutschland. Das ist nicht das Geschäft, das ist die Plattform. Darauf bauen wir neue Verticals auf: Versicherung, Energie, Finanzierung und Brokerage. Für Brokerage suchen wir jetzt die Person, die daraus ein echtes Geschäft macht.

Darum geht es

Viele unserer Eigentümer wollen irgendwann verkaufen oder neu vermieten. Wir sitzen direkt an der Quelle und kennen Objekte, Eigentümer und Timing. Deine Aufgabe ist, daraus eine planbare Akquise-Maschine zu bauen: Du identifizierst die richtigen Eigentümer aus unserem Bestand, sprichst sie gezielt an und wandelst erstes Interesse in hochqualifizierte Leads für unsere Makler um.

Das ist keine Strategie-Rolle mit Folien und Roadmaps. Du baust selbst: Kampagnen, Outbound-Workflows, Automatisierungen, Funnels. Du weißt jede Woche, welche Zahl du bewegt hast. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Leadership-Team, ohne Hierarchie-Ebenen dazwischen.

Was du machst

  • Akquise-Engine aufbauen: Du analysierst unseren Bestand, findest Eigentümer mit Verkaufs- oder Vermietungsbedarf und baust Workflows für Datenanreicherung, Lead-Scoring und automatisierte Ansprache.

  • Marketing selbst umsetzen: Du baust und optimierst die Kanäle, die Leads bringen, von Outbound über Performance-Kampagnen bis zu In-App-Triggern im richtigen Moment.

  • Funnel und Zahlen verantworten: Du definierst KPIs vom Lead bis zum Mandat, trackst Kosten pro Lead und Conversion und optimierst so lange, bis die Unit Economics stimmen.

  • Schnell testen: Daten-Trigger, Kanäle, Messaging und Lead-Magneten. Du hast eine klare Meinung, was du ausprobieren willst, und misst es sauber.

Was du mitbringst

  • 3+ Jahre operative Erfahrung in Growth oder Performance Marketing, mit eigener Verantwortung für Leads, Conversion oder Umsatz.

  • Du hast Dinge von null aufgebaut, etwa als Gründer:in, als Geschäftsführer:in eines kleinen Unternehmens oder in einer frühen Startup-Phase. Das ist für uns ein starkes Signal.

  • Hands-on-Erfahrung mit datengetriebener Akquise: Outbound, Datenanreicherung, CRM und Automatisierung.

  • Marketing-Erfahrung mit Performance-Kanälen und Kampagnen ist ein klares Plus.

  • Erfahrung in Immobilien, PropTech oder Marktplätzen ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (mindestens C1). Du sprichst täglich mit Eigentümern und unseren Hausverwaltungen.

  • Du lebst in Berlin oder ziehst her und reist gern zu unseren Standorten in ganz Deutschland.

Bitte nicht bewerben, wenn

  • du vor allem Strategie machen und die Umsetzung anderen überlassen willst,

  • du erst ein Team führen möchtest, bevor das Modell bewiesen ist,

  • du nicht bereit bist, in Berlin zu arbeiten.

Was wir bieten

  • Ein Vertical, das du von Anfang an prägst, mit 70.000 Einheiten als Basis und voller Rückendeckung vom Leadership-Team.

  • Ein Inside-Sales-Team, auf das du zugreifen kannst: Es übernimmt Anrufe und die Bearbeitung deiner Kampagnen, damit du dich auf den Aufbau der Akquise-Engine konzentrieren kannst.

  • Einen direkten Weg zur Verantwortung: Wenn Brokerage funktioniert, skalierst du es weiter.

  • 110 € Lunch-Budget und 50 € Fitness-Zuschuss pro Monat, täglich Frühstück und Spezialitäten-Kaffee im Office.

  • 1.200 € Weiterbildungsbudget pro Jahr.

data.description:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

At RobCo, we don’t just build robots, we are redefining the relationship between hardware and AI. Our end-to-end solutions seamlessly combine advanced, scalable industrial hardware with a central software suite powered by Physical AI to make manufacturing truly autonomous, efficient, and scalable. By delivering field-ready robotic solutions that just work, we empower industrial companies to automate without complexity and successfully solve the global labor shortage.

At RobCo, we automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary. To achieve this, we are looking for an ambitious Engineering Manager - Control & Low-Level Software (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as a leading provider of automation solutions.

In this key role, you will lead the team behind how our robots move: RobControl, the real-time controller running on every RobCo robot, together with control unit software, robot modeling and hardware integration. One controller codebase drives our modular robots, OEM configurations and Alfie, our autonomous industrial robot, so your team's work reaches every robot in the field. Managing a team of control, embedded and software engineers, you will balance new capabilities for Alfie and our physical AI roadmap with the reliability factory customers expect on every shift.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own the hardware-software bridge: Lead the team developing our real-time controller, robot models, hardware interfacing via EtherCat, as well as core robot algorithms like motion generation and planning, calibration, etc., running on Linux-based Control Units.

  • Lead and Grow the Team: Act as a people-first leader for a mixed team of experienced engineers and early-career talent. Hire and coach, and balance roadmap work with field support through clear priorities and a fair on-call rotation.

  • Drive Engineering Excellence: Set standards for code quality, hardware-in-the-loop and automated testing, and CI/CD, so that done means tested, released and running in the field. Improve observability so field issues can be diagnosed remotely and quickly.

  • One Platform for Every Robot: Keep one controller codebase for modular robots, OEM configurations and Alfie, extending it to new kinematic structures, more joints and multi-arm systems without forking it. Manage technical debt and architectural health as we scale.

  • Partner Across Teams: Work with Product Management, Hardware, Safety & Compliance and Robot Intelligence to turn customer and autonomy needs into a clear roadmap, integrate RobControl with the safety controller, and support certification against ISO 10218 and ISO 13849.

  • Cross-Team Leadership: Mentor junior EMs and help evolve company-wide engineering best practices and software-first principles.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Completed a university degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field.

  • 3+ years of experience leading engineering teams that ship real-time or embedded software for robots, motion systems or other industrial machines.

  • Deep experience in robot control and motion is a big plus: kinematics and dynamics, trajectory generation, and position, velocity and torque control. Strong C++ and Python on real-time Linux, with hands-on EtherCAT and ROS 2 experience.

  • Proven track record of driving an AI-first engineering culture and implementing agentic workflows that measurably accelerate team velocity and system efficiency.

  • Expert knowledge of modern SDLC practices for software that runs on hardware, including hardware-in-the-loop testing and staged releases, with a track record of improving release frequency and field stability.

  • Working knowledge of functional safety for industrial robots (ISO 10218, ISO 13849) and experience working closely with safety and certification teams.

  • Culture-aligned mindset characterized by hardware empathy, a passion for software-defined hardware, and a strong culture of high ownership.

  • Very good English skills with the ability to navigate complex architectural discussions with Staff engineers while clearly communicating risks to stakeholders.

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Work out across Germany in over 7,200 studios with our subsidized Wellpass membership.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and—depending on the role—the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events—from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. In October 2026, RobCo reached unicorn status with a valuation exceeding one billion US dollars, with its valuation doubling in less than nine months. With $200M raised from investors including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Lingotto, Kindred, Cherry Ventures, and the European Tech Collective, 225+ people globally, and 3.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our Bay Area Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

Who we are

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter, Noah Hollmann, and Sauraj Gambhir, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

The role

Most enterprises will never call our API directly. They will meet TabPFN inside the platforms they already run: SAP, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Databricks, or their own cloud. How well that works, how fast each release arrives there, and which platforms come next is the job of our Technical Product Manager for Integrations.

You take each model release from handover to live across every channel, working with the engineers who build the model and the partner teams who host it. Inside SAP you carry the product side of TabPFN across its platforms, from AI Core to SAP Analytics Cloud, and you help build the integration engineering team that will work with you. Several decisions are yours to bring to the table: which announced channels we build next, what a marketplace listing should cost, how support for all of this works.

You work directly with our product team, our engineers and the founders, and you report to the CTO. This suits someone who enjoys landing things on a date as much as deciding what to build, and who still likes being close to the code.

What you'll do

  • Take every model release live across SAP, the cloud marketplaces and customer environments, on a plan you build with product and engineering.

  • Be the technical counterpart for the partner teams that host TabPFN, from SAP's platform teams to the hyperscaler marketplaces.

  • Shape how TabPFN shows up inside SAP's stack and what the integration engineering team builds first.

  • Bring the open channel decisions to the founders with a recommendation, and stay hands-on: listings, docs, smoke tests, a PR when it is faster than asking.

What we're looking for

  • Two or more years as product manager for a platform or integration surface: a product that ships into partners' platforms, or that other companies build on.

  • You have shipped through gates you did not control, landed multi-team releases on dates, and made a large enterprise's process work for a small, fast team.

  • You started as an engineer and never fully stopped: you read code, logs and scan reports without a translator.

  • You are in Berlin or ready to relocate; Freiburg or New York can work.

What sets you apart

  • You have shipped into an SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft or Oracle ecosystem, or know the cloud marketplaces from the inside.

  • You have deployed machine learning models and know what GPUs cost.

  • You have worked at a startup, and you use AI tools to take real work off your plate.

Life at Prior Labs

You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right.

Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together.

Our Commitments

The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are.

We care about how your data is handled - see our Recruiting Data Privacy page

Description

QuantumDiamonds is building the world’s first commercial quantum sensing tools for chip failure analysis. As our Research Software Engineering Intern in Pre-Development, you bring our measurement software together. A measurement protocol is the recipe our Quantum Diamond Microscope (QDm) follows for one measurement: how laser, microwaves and camera are sequenced and timed, and how raw camera frames become a magnetic field image of a chip. Our engineers write new protocols whenever they test a new idea, and several backends for running them grew in parallel. You turn them into one shared Python framework that our engineers extend.

The challenge is a framework R&D still uses long after your internship: flexible enough that a new protocol is a day’s work, automated enough that a measurement runs without someone watching it, and structured enough that the next engineer extends it without reading all of it. An experienced colleague from the team mentors you and sets the architecture; you make that trade-off real in code, working with Claude Code every day, as our engineers do.

This is a full-time internship for 6 months, during or after your studies, starting as soon as possible.

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

 
 

What will you do

  • Bring the measurement software of Pre-Development together into one shared Python framework, to a target architecture your mentor defines, and migrate the existing measurement protocols onto it.

  • Keep the CI/CD pipeline on GitHub Actions healthy as the framework grows: tests, linting, packaging, releases.

  • Give first-pass reviews on pull requests from our engineers (tests, conventions, API conformance) before your mentor approves them.

  • Help our engineers extend the stack: new measurement protocols become modules in the framework, and you validate the migrated ones on our QDm systems together with them.

  • Document the framework and hand it over so the team runs it on its own after your internship.

 

What is expected of you

  • Enrolled in or recently graduated from a degree program in computer science, software engineering, computational engineering, physics or electrical engineering with a strong software focus.

  • Available full time for 6 months, starting as soon as possible.

  • Python is your working language: you structure packages, write type hints and tests, and have refactored or consolidated code you did not write.

  • Git and CI are routine for you, and you know how to make hardware-dependent code testable: mocked instruments, recorded data and simulation, with runs on real hardware as a separate stage.

  • AI coding agents are part of how you work, and you check their output the way you check your own.

  • You review code and take review well, you can agree on a common interface with engineers who each prefer their own solution, and you treat your colleagues as your users.

  • Fluent in English. On-site in Munich.

Experience with instrument control or lab automation in Python, with frameworks such as qudi, QCoDeS or PyMeasure, or contributions to open-source projects are a plus, not required. What we want you to bring is the patience to read code you did not write and the discipline to leave it better structured than you found it.

Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

  • Mentoring: An experienced colleague from the team mentors you throughout your internship.

  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 24 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

What is expected of you

Nice to have:

  • Skills in soldering, precision mechanics, vacuum technology, 3D printing, or basic CAD.

  • Hands-on experience with optics, lasers, or photonics, or a laser safety qualification.

Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

What You’ll Own

You meet with the relevant operators, engineers, customers, and stakeholders.

You separate customer requests from actual product requirements.

You identify edge cases and unresolved decisions.

You write a product specification that clearly explains the intended behavior, workflows, system states, requirements, and open questions.

The Head of Product provides direction and reviews the most important decisions—but does not need to personally produce every artifact or manage every follow-up.

We are not looking for someone who spends six months observing before contributing.

You can take a complicated conversation and turn it into a clear product definition.

You have strong product judgment and are comfortable making reasonable decisions when requirements are incomplete.

You understand that a customer request is not automatically a product requirement.

You are technically curious and capable of participating meaningfully in discussions with software engineers, systems engineers, operators, and external partners.

Particularly Valuable Experience

It is not a Scrum Master role.

It is not someone whose primary contribution is scheduling meetings, maintaining Jira, or writing meeting minutes.

The primary contribution is:

understanding product problems and defining excellent solutions.

Success After 90 Days

Der Plan steht, jetzt fehlst du: Bring unsere Software von Legacy-PHP auf Symfony und React.

Auf einen Blick

  • Stack: PHP 8.1 (Legacy) → Symfony · jQuery/Vanilla-JS → React · MySQL/MariaDB, SingleStore · Git, CI/CD

  • Vertrag: unbefristet, Vollzeit

  • Arbeitsmodell: hybrid, 3 Tage Büro / 2 Tage remote

Die Rolle

Unser Kernprodukt Konsentas ist über viele Jahre gewachsen, und das sieht man dem Code an. Das Backend läuft auf PHP 8.1 ohne Framework. Im Frontend stehen jQuery und Vanilla-JS neben React, und automatisierte Tests gibt es bisher wenige.

Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität.

Du triffst eigenständig technische Entscheidungen, bringst dich in Architektur- und Modernisierungsfragen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Codequalität mit jedem Release besser wird. Dabei bleibt das Produkt im Einsatz: Wartung, Support und neue Features laufen parallel zur Modernisierung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Legacy-Module bei laufendem Betrieb schrittweise durch Symfony-Services und React-Oberflächen ersetzen

  • Fullstack-Features von der Datenbank bis zum Frontend entwickeln, teils auch als kundenspezifische Erweiterungen

  • Bestehenden Legacy-Code pflegen, debuggen und weiterentwickeln

  • Code-Reviews durchführen und die Testabdeckung ausbauen

  • Mit Entwicklungsleitung und Geschäftsführung abstimmen, welche Bereiche als Nächstes modernisiert werden

  • Unsere zwei Auszubildenden im letzten Ausbildungsabschnitt fachlich begleiten (ohne disziplinarische Führung)

  • Gelegentlich an Kundenterminen teilnehmen, etwa alle 3–4 Wochen

Nach 6 Monaten …

… setzt du Features eigenständig um, hast spürbar zur Modernisierung beigetragen, die Codequalität verbessert und bist für unsere Azubis eine feste Ansprechperson.

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze)

  • PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID

  • Symfony: nachweisbare Praxiserfahrung mit dem Framework

  • Legacy-Code: Du gehst sicher mit gewachsenen Codebasen um. Du refaktorierst, debuggst und entwickelst weiter, ohne alles neu zu schreiben.

  • JavaScript/React: solide Erfahrung im Frontend, jQuery schreckt dich nicht ab

  • Datenbanken: relationale Datenbanken wie MySQL/MariaDB oder SingleStore und sicherer Umgang mit SQL

  • Sprache: Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch mindestens B1

  • Arbeitsweise: eigenständig, strukturiert, proaktiv und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch

  • Persönlich: Du kommunizierst verlässlich, arbeitest gern im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung, hast keine Angst vor schwierigen Codestellen und gibst dein Wissen gern weiter.

  • Abschluss: Ausbildung oder FH-Abschluss zählen bei uns genauso viel wie ein Uni-Studium. Entscheidend ist deine Praxiserfahrung.

Pluspunkte: REST/API-Design und Schnittstellenentwicklung, automatisiertes Testing (PHPUnit, Jest), Docker, Deployment-Pipelines und Cloud, Software-Architektur und Design

-

Patterns, produktiver Einsatz von KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder Codex. Erfahrung mit Software für den öffentlichen Sektor ist nicht nötig.

Dein Team

Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen: Daniel (Developer Lead), Nico (Geschäftsführer & Projektmanager), der selbst aktiv mitentwickelt, ein externer Entwickler und zwei Auszubildende. Ihr stimmt euch täglich ab. Daniel und Nico übernehmen dein Onboarding persönlich.

So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess

Über Girona

Seit über 25 Jahren entwickelt die Girona Softwareentwicklung GmbH in Berlin Software für die öffentliche Verwaltung. Städte wie Berlin, München, Bonn und Dessau setzen seit Jahrzehnten auf unsere Lösungen, Konsentas etwa in Bürgerämtern, Gesundheitsämtern sowie Kfz-Zulassungs- und Führerscheinstellen.

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. Bist du begeistert von dieser Gelegenheit, denn Du wirst...

Unsere bescheidenen Erwartungen

  • Du hast eine positive Einstellung und einen unternehmerischen Geist

  • Du bist kundenorientiert – du hast eine kundenorientierte Mentalität und bist in der Lage, mit Menschen unterschiedlichen technischen Niveaus zusammenzuarbeiten

  • Du bist in der Lage, dir Ziele zu setzen und diese auch zu erreichen
  • Du bist organisiert, sorgfältig und verfügst über tadellose Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
  • Du arbeitest gut in unabhängigen und vielfältigen Teamumgebungen
  • Du bist bereit für eine Herausforderung und fühlst dich als Teamplayer wohl
  • Du verfügst über analytische Fähigkeiten und kritisches Denken
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch (mindestens C1) – jede weitere Sprache ist ein Plus

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. About the Team

Our Infrastructure teams build the foundation that engineers at Wolt, Deliveroo, and DoorDash build on: the compute, cloud, and networking capabilities that enable Engineering teams to develop, deploy, and run services at global scale. The EU Compute team has a specific focus on provisioning, scaling, and the efficient operation of GPU infrastructure for AI and ML workloads. This is an emerging space with plenty of greenfield opportunities.

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to be a hands-on technical leader for this infrastructure work that crosses team and brand boundaries. You'll set direction for the platform, turn complex problems into deliverable plans, write and review production code, and help other engineers make sound decisions. It's an exciting time to join: we're building a global platform and the choices made now will shape how engineers across the company ship for years.

What you'll be doing

You'll own some of the hardest infrastructure problems in the company and make the platform easier to operate and safer to build on. We're determined to build great platform products and user experiences, and you'll be pivotal in making this reality.

Day-to-day in this role you'll:

  • Set technical direction for shared AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure, balancing reliability, security, developer experience, and cost.
  • Lead substantial initiatives from design through rollout and operation, coordinating dependencies and decisions across Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash, focusing on workloads targeting GPUs.
  • Evolve Kubernetes clusters, cloud networking, identity, and infrastructure provisioning to support growing and varied workloads.
  • Build reusable Terraform patterns and self-service tooling that help teams provision infrastructure safely and consistently.
  • Improve deployment and operational practices, including GitOps, observability, capacity planning, incident response and recovery.
  • Use production signals and developer feedback to find platform friction, choose where to invest and measure whether changes actually help.
  • Assist with supporting the platform, with deep focus on GPU infrastructure, as well as broad focus on compute in general.
  • Gracefully sunset legacy infrastructure and tooling, and create strategies to reduce toil.
  • Mentor engineers through design reviews, implementation and incidents, raising the quality of infrastructure work across teams.

Our humble expectations

  • Deep experience building and operating Kubernetes and AWS infrastructure in production. Familiarity with GPU workloads and orchestration is a plus.
  • Strong software engineering skills: you use Go, Python or a similar language to build maintainable tools and automation.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (we use Terraform) and with designing systems that other engineering teams depend on.
  • A track record of leading complex technical work across teams, including architectural decisions, delivery, and operational follow-through. You have the breadth to collaborate and design across team and domain boundaries, and the depth to have hands-on impact.
  • Strong judgment on trade-offs in distributed systems, networking, security, reliability, and cloud cost.
  • Clear communication, and the ability to bring people together around a practical technical direction.

What we offer

  • Scope and influence. Shape infrastructure used globally, while staying close to the engineering. Your work will help product teams ship services with greater ease and confidence.
  • Real problems at global scale. Multi-cluster Kubernetes, AI / ML workloads, cloud networking, GitOps, and progressive delivery across a global company.
  • Autonomy and ownership. Set direction and see it through from design to operation, with the backing of a global engineering organisation spanning Europe and the US.

Bei Helix entwickeln wir einen live KI-Coach, der Vertrieblern während den deals hilft diese zu gewinnen. mehr auf helix-cx.com

Wir sind ein junges Startup aus München und suchen ambitionierte Studierende, die gemeinsam mit uns wachsen, vom ersten Tag an Verantwortung übernehmen und einen der wertvollsten Skills im Geschäftsleben entwickeln wollen: Vertrieb.

Über die Rolle

Als Business Development Representative (BDR) hilfst du uns dabei, unseren Outbound-Vertrieb aufzubauen und neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu schaffen.

Du bist der erste Kontaktpunkt für potenzielle Kunden, identifizierst ihre Herausforderungen, weckst Interesse an unserer Lösung und verwandelst erste Gespräche in qualifizierte Verkaufschancen.

Das ist eine praktische Vertriebsrolle. Einen großen Teil deiner Zeit wirst du mit Cold Calling verbringen, direkt mit Entscheidern sprechen, Einwände behandeln und lernen, wie man neue Kunden gewinnt.

Du arbeitest eng mit den Gründern zusammen, erhältst direktes Feedback und übernimmst von Anfang an echte Verantwortung.

Deine Perspektive: Diese Rolle soll mehr sein als ein klassischer Werkstudentenjob. Bei guter Performance hast du die Möglichkeit, dich zum Account Executive (AE) weiterzuentwickeln, eigene Verkaufschancen zu übernehmen und schließlich selbstständig Deals abzuschließen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Prospecting: Identifiziere und recherchiere potenzielle Kunden, Zielunternehmen und relevante Entscheidungsträger.

  • Outbound Sales: Übernimm die aktive Ansprache potenzieller Kunden durch Cold Calling, E-Mail und LinkedIn, um qualifizierte Verkaufschancen zu generieren.

  • Kundengespräche: Verstehe die Herausforderungen potenzieller Kunden, vermittle den Mehrwert unserer Lösung, behandle Einwände und vereinbare Termine.

  • Sales Strategy: Teste unterschiedliche Ansprachemethoden, Botschaften und Vertriebstechniken, um unsere Conversion Rates kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

  • Pipeline Development: Hilf dabei, unsere Sales-Pipeline aufzubauen und zu verwalten und erste Gespräche in konkrete Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu verwandeln.

  • Deal Ownership: Übernimm mit wachsender Erfahrung mehr Verantwortung im gesamten Sales-Prozess – von Discovery Calls bis hin zum eigenständigen Abschluss von Deals.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Schnelle Karriereentwicklung: Die Möglichkeit, dich vom BDR zum Account Executive weiterzuentwickeln, eigene Deals zu übernehmen und deine Karriere im B2B-Vertrieb aufzubauen.

  • Ungedeckelte Provision: Leistung zählt. Je erfolgreicher du bist, desto mehr kannst du verdienen – ohne Obergrenze bei der Provision.

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern: Arbeite eng mit dem Gründerteam zusammen, erhalte persönliches Coaching und lerne, wie man ein Unternehmen von Grund auf aufbaut.

  • Echte Verantwortung: Du bist nicht hier, um nur zuzuschauen. Du übernimmst eigenständig die Kundenansprache, sprichst mit echten Entscheidern und trägst direkt zu unserem Wachstum bei.

  • Flexible Teilzeit: Verbinde dein Studium mit einer verantwortungsvollen Tätigkeit in einem schnell wachsenden Startup.

  • KI- und Startup-Erfahrung: Arbeite an der Schnittstelle von künstlicher Intelligenz, Technologie und Business Development.

Was wir von dir erwarten

  • Du bist aktuell an einer Universität oder Hochschule eingeschrieben und möchtest neben deinem Studium praktische Business-Erfahrung sammeln.

  • Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse und hast Spaß daran, mit Menschen zu kommunizieren.

  • Du bist ehrgeizig, proaktiv und motiviert, messbare Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

  • Du hast kein Problem damit, auf fremde Menschen zuzugehen, Fragen zu stellen und mit Ablehnung umzugehen.

  • Du interessierst dich für KI, Startups und die Frage, wie Unternehmen wachsen.

  • Du arbeitest zuverlässig, eigenständig und möchtest dich kontinuierlich verbessern.

  • Erste Erfahrungen in Sales, Business Development, Recruiting, Consulting oder anderen kundenorientierten Tätigkeiten sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Dein Ehrgeiz, deine Einstellung und deine Lernbereitschaft sind uns wichtiger als deine bisherige Erfahrung oder deine Noten.

Warum Helix?

Lerne einen der wertvollsten Skills im Geschäftsleben.
Egal, ob du später selbst gründen, ins Consulting gehen oder eine Karriere im Vertrieb aufbauen möchtest: Die Fähigkeit, überzeugend zu kommunizieren, zu verhandeln und zu verkaufen, wird dir immer einen entscheidenden Vorteil verschaffen.

Bei Helix lernst du durch praktische Erfahrung. Du sprichst mit echten Entscheidern, verstehst, wie Unternehmen Kaufentscheidungen treffen, und erlebst aus erster Hand, wie aus einem ersten Gespräch ein zahlender Kunde wird.

Wachse mit dem Unternehmen.
Wir bauen unseren Vertrieb von Grund auf auf. Das bedeutet, dass du die Möglichkeit hast, Prozesse mitzugestalten, neue Strategien zu testen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen, für die du in einem größeren Unternehmen normalerweise deutlich länger brauchen würdest.

Deine Leistung bestimmt deine Möglichkeiten.
Wir suchen Menschen, die lernen und Verantwortung übernehmen wollen. Wenn du konstant gute Ergebnisse lieferst, bekommst du die Möglichkeit, über die reine Kundenakquise hinauszuwachsen, eigene Verkaufsgespräche zu führen und Deals abzuschließen.

Wisse, worauf du dich einlässt.
Vertrieb ist nicht immer einfach. Du wirst viele Anrufe tätigen, häufig ein Nein hören und Gespräche führen, die zu nichts führen. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du dadurch Durchhaltevermögen, Selbstbewusstsein und die Fähigkeit, andere Menschen zu überzeugen – Fähigkeiten, die dich dein gesamtes Berufsleben begleiten werden.

So bewirbst du dich

Wir suchen keinen perfekten Lebenslauf und erwarten keine jahrelange Berufserfahrung.

Stell dich noch in einem video kurz vor, erzähle uns, was du studierst und warum du Lust auf Vertrieb hast.

Wir möchten vor allem einen ersten Eindruck von dir als Person bekommen. Ein professionell produziertes Video ist nicht notwendig.

Wenn du ehrgeizig bist, Herausforderungen magst und lernen möchtest, wie man erfolgreich verkauft, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models.
