Role: Product Designer-Builder

Company: StellarTech

Location: Remote. StellarTech has offices in Warsaw and Cyprus if you'd like to work from one. The team overlaps 10:00–16:00 CET. Search focus: Poland, Czech Republic, Romania, Serbia, Georgia, Kazakhstan, Armenia, Cyprus, Dubai and the wider Middle East; Western Europe is also possible. We can't consider Russia, Belarus or Ukraine at the moment.

Job Type: Full-time, B2B contract

Compensation: €4,500–5,500/month gross, paid in USD

About StellarTech

StellarTech is a self-funded multi-app company that launches consumer mobile products in different domains. It is profitable, moves at startup pace and is aiming for $1B in revenue.

You would join Smartimi, the company's biggest and most mature app, as the design partner of its PM, Darya. Around you: a content team that builds templates, a product analyst, engineers and QA. The Head of Product has a UX background himself. The team speaks Russian; the users speak English.

What you are expected to do:

  • Take raw problems, ideas and initiatives and turn them into flows, prototypes and shipped UI for a consumer mobile app.

  • Work as a pair with the PM, and own some initiatives fully, from idea to release to reading the numbers.

  • Work directly with engineers and review the build before it ships.

  • Run A/B tests, read the results in Amplitude and plan the next iteration.

  • Talk to users: run interviews in English and launch quick surveys.

  • Build features yourself with vibe-coding or no-code tools when that's faster. The team has a way to test and ship them.

Marketing banners and funnels are handled by a separate team, so they are not part of this role.

What you need to succeed:

  • 3+ years in product design, with at least 2 (ideally 3) in consumer mobile apps. B2B-only backgrounds won't be a fit.

  • Strong, modern mobile UX and UI craft. The Head of Product looks closely at portfolios, so yours should show it.

  • Ownership: when a problem lands on your desk, you carry it through without waiting to be told the next step.

  • Product thinking: you care about product metrics and experiments, not only the interface.

  • Experience running user interviews. Usability testing and research methods can be learned on the job.

  • English at B2–C1 and Russian.

  • Clear, structured communication, including when you're thinking out loud with the team.

  • You enjoy a high pace and take direct feedback well.

  • You want to build good things for users, not just hit numbers at any cost.

  • Nice to have: an app or side project you launched yourself, and builder or no-code skills.

What you get:

  • A direct partnership with a strong PM, and a Head of Product who cares about design.

  • Real ownership, access to analytics and A/B data, and room to build things yourself.

  • Remote work, offices in Warsaw and Cyprus, and an offsite about once a year.

  • 21 calendar days of paid vacation plus 10 public holidays of your country, and 7 paid sick days.

  • €50/month towards health insurance after probation, and a MacBook Air (13" or 15").

  • €4,500–5,500/month gross on a B2B contract with StellarTech's Cyprus entity, paid in USD. You'll need your own sole proprietorship. Probation is 3 months.

How to apply

Apply through hirehire: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/hirehire/348181a6-cb98-4401-86cb-a1ca508b9e3c. Add your LinkedIn profile or CV and a link to your portfolio. If your portfolio is password-protected, include the password in your application. The process: a 30-minute call with hirehire, a portfolio review with the Head of Product, an interview with the PM, a 30-minute call with the Head of Product, and a live whiteboard challenge in Figma with the team. It usually takes about a week.

data.title: Senior AI Engineer

data.description:
Neural Frames is a leading AI music video generator, turning any song into a fully produced music video in minutes. We're bootstrapped, profitable, and generating more than $7M in annualized revenue. Our ambition is to build a category-defining company that helps tens of millions of audio creators visualize and promote their work.

Organic search has historically been our most important acquisition channel: product pages, free tools and landing pages in many languages that bring musicians and creators to us every day. It has never had a dedicated owner. At the same time, search is changing faster than at any point in the last decade, and more and more discovery happens inside AI answers on Google, ChatGPT and Perplexity.

We're looking for our first Senior SEO & GEO Manager to own organic acquisition end to end: decide what we build and why, make it genuinely useful, get it shipped, and show what it changed in signups and paying customers.

This is an individual contributor role with real ownership. You'll work directly with the founder, with our engineers on implementation, and with our content and creator team. We're looking for people with high agency and a bias to action.

Tasks

  • Own our organic search strategy and a prioritized roadmap: which pages, tools and fixes, in what order, and the business reason behind each

  • Diagnose and prioritize technical SEO on a modern Next.js site - crawling, indexing, rendering, site architecture, internal linking, canonicals, structured data, hreflang and speed - and ship - where possible - updates to it yourself with AI

  • Research search intent and turn it into acquisition pages and free tools that genuinely help musicians, labels and creators, and that bring them into the product

  • Write, edit and improve English landing pages and briefs yourself, and keep quality high across our localized pages

  • Expand our approach to AI search: define the prompts that matter, measure where we appear and which sources AI answers rely on, run documented experiments, and get Neural Frames into the places those answers come from

  • Earn relevant authority through partnerships, PR, communities and honest comparisons

  • Report from discovery to qualified signup and first payment, separate brand from non-brand, and be clear about what attribution can and cannot show

  • Run one shared SEO and GEO backlog with engineering and content, and follow every item through to launch and measurement

Requirements

  • You have personally owned organic acquisition and can show what your work changed in qualified traffic, signups, paying customers or revenue - including the baseline, the timeframe and your own contribution

  • You have strong technical SEO fundamentals, including JavaScript-rendered sites, and you turn audits into realistic, prioritized implementation plans

  • You’re a heavy creator of AI workflows, but retain the human touch

  • You write excellent English and have sharp judgment about search intent. You can write a landing page that ranks and converts, not just brief one

  • You have run concrete AI-search experiments and can explain how you measured them, what failed, and what you're still unsure about

  • You're comfortable in Search Console, an SEO research tool such as Ahrefs or Semrush, and product analytics such as PostHog

  • You work independently: you find opportunities, prioritize them and get them done without waiting for someone to prepare the tasks

  • You are based in Berlin or ready to relocate, and can join us in the office at least four days per week

Bonus points:

  • Organic growth experience with an international self-serve subscription, creative tool or consumer SaaS product

  • Product-led free tools, useful programmatic SEO, or multilingual sites

  • You make music or video yourself, or know AI creation workflows well

Benefits

VSOPs & Profit Sharing. Bi-weekly team lunches, regular team events, an annual summer offsite, learning & development support, productivity tools, a one-time headphone budget, Deutschlandticket, and a €5,000 referral bonus.

neural frames is dedicated to creating an equitable, inclusive, and supportive work environment that brings people together from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Our strength is in our differences. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants as we're committed to promoting a culture of opportunity for all.

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

About The Exploration Company

At The Exploration Company, we are developing, producing and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable orbital space vehicle that aims to eventually be refuelled in orbit, carrying cargo and potentially humans in the long run. The heart of a spacecraft lies in its engine, which is why we develop our own propulsion systems, aiming for the highest level of efficiency and reliability.

Role Summary

We are seeking a Junior Engine Control System & Monitoring Engineer to join the engine control and monitoring team of Storm, our high-thrust LOX/LCH4 cryogenic rocket engine. Working alongside senior control engineers, you will develop and test control and monitoring algorithms, work with the engine functional models provided by the functional team, contribute to setting up the controller development environment, and help verify the controller through Model-, Software- and Hardware-in-the-Loop testing and during engine test campaigns. This is an entry-level, hands-on role for a recent graduate with strong control fundamentals who wants to learn on real hardware and progressively grow into full ownership of safety-critical engine control functions.

Key responsibilities:

1. Control & Monitoring Algorithm Development

• Design and implement engine control and monitoring algorithms, following the software team's rules, guidelines and auto-coding practices.

• Contribute to the definition of the engine regulation strategy (thrust and mixture ratio control, chill-down, start-up and shutdown transients) together with functional and system engineers.

• Support the definition of control and monitoring requirements for engine subsystems (valves, pumps, sensors, controller, software).

2. Simulation & Controller Development Environment

• Contribute to setting up the controller development environment: toolchain, model and code configuration management, auto-coding chain, and the MiL/SiL/HiL simulation and test infrastructure.

• Integrate the engine functional models delivered by the functional team (turbopumps, valves, combustion devices, cryogenic feed lines; steady-state, transient and chill-down) into the control design and simulation environment, deriving simplified or linearised models for controller synthesis where needed.

• Run closed-loop simulations to assess controller performance, stability margins and robustness to model uncertainties.

• Feed test results back to the functional team to support model correlation, and flag model limitations that matter for control.

3. Health Monitoring & Fault Management

• Contribute to the engine monitoring strategy that assesses the health status of the engine and its subsystems (combustion chamber, turbopumps, valves…).

• Implement fault detection and sensor validation logic for both real-time protection and post-test analysis.

• Support failure mode analyses (FMEA) and the management of failure modes, paving the way for engine reusability.

4. Validation, Testing & Documentation

• Prepare and run Model-, Software- and Hardware-in-the-Loop (MiL, SiL, HiL) test campaigns to verify the control and monitoring functions at each step, from Simulink model to embedded code on target hardware.

• Support Storm engine and component cryogenic (LOX/LCH4) test campaigns: test preparation, on-site support, data processing and post-test analysis.

• Produce clear development documentation: specifications, test procedures, test reports and justification files.

What we would love to see from you:

• Master's degree (or equivalent) in Aerospace, Electrical, Control or Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Recent graduate (or graduating within the next months); no professional experience required. A master's thesis, internship or academic project in control, propulsion or embedded systems is a strong plus.

• Solid fundamentals in control theory, both classical and modern (state-space, robustness, digital control).

• Practical use of MATLAB/Simulink and Python through coursework or projects; basic knowledge of C/C++.

• Basic understanding of fluid dynamics and thermodynamics, and a strong interest in cryogenic propulsion and turbomachinery.

• Fluent in English.

Nice to Have:

• Exposure to MiL/SiL/HiL testing or real-time embedded systems.

• Experience with auto-coding from Simulink models.

• Familiarity with safety-critical design practices, reliability engineering or failure mode analysis.

• Interest or experience in data science applied to health monitoring and anomaly detection.

• Knowledge of space standards (ECSS, MIL-STD, NASA-HBK…).

• German and/or French.

Skills & Behaviours:

• Eagerness to learn and to take on increasing ownership under the guidance of senior engineers.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to draw useful conclusions from partial or contradictory data.

• Clear oral and written communication; comfortable working closely with engine, avionics, software and test teams.

• Organised, able to prioritise tasks and deliver within time constraints.

• Positive, flexible attitude and enthusiasm for space exploration.

• Behaviour consistent with The Exploration Company's core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. data.description:
What is working at Bettermile like?

  • 🌟 We have a very supportive and appreciative working environment with a lot of autonomy, a flat hierarchy, and professional growth possibilities

  • 🌍 We mean diversity and we put it in numbers: 40 languages, 40 nationalities, 40% female (vs. ø26% in tech industry), and yes, we do have Schlager-Fans among us

  • 🚀 You can quickly take on responsibility without feeling left alone. Your team is always at your side

  • 🎨 We mean it when we say “cutting edge” and have a high level of creative freedom in our everyday work

  • 🏢 We work in a hybrid mode with weekly team days for better collaboration and nurturing interpersonal connections. When onsite - we work in a modern kid & pet-friendly Better Space in the heart of Berlin-Kreuzberg

  • ✈️ Remote work from anywhere for up to 12 weeks in total in a year

  • 🛌 Enjoy 27 vacation days (with a 5-day week model)

  • 🍎 Regular team breakfasts, fitness & wellness classes, company runs, and other events. Fruits, snacks, drinks, and coffee with a variety of milk are a given - but yes, we have them

  • 💡 Outstanding flexibility we are proud of – and of course, the best colleagues in the world!

 

About the User Insights & Support Team:

 

Our team is like a navigation system for the successful experience of our users.

We don't just improve performance. We consider individual needs to provide customized training and resources tailored specifically to our clients. Interaction is at the heart of what we do. We look forward to answering questions and getting to the bottom of uncertainties.

We are proud to have an open door for feedback, because our customers' opinions drive change and improvement. We have a few pre-defined solutions, because we believe that every path should be unique.

The UsIS team is more than ‘just’ support. We are comrades-in-arms, believing in the vision and encouraging each other to take each step with confidence.

You will be taking care of

  • Writing scripts for and editing driver-facing tutorial and onboarding videos that help our users get started and grow with confidence

  • Designing materials such as one-pagers, posters, and merch for our depots, often on short notice

  • Assisting in managing our driver merch from start to finish, including finding vendors, keeping track of budget and orders, and organizing delivery to the depots

  • Taking on regular support shifts, helping users directly and gaining first-hand insight into what they really need

  • Turning what you learn in support into better visual content, so our videos and materials answer the questions users actually have

You check these boxes

  • You are proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro/DaVinci/Avid and you pick up new tools quickly

  • You have a good eye for clear, engaging visual storytelling

  • You genuinely enjoy supporting users and see support shifts as a valuable part of the role

  • You welcome feedback and use it to make your work better

  • You are a team player who stays humble, reliable, and happy to take on the tasks the team needs most

  • You work in an organized, detail-oriented way and keep track of several projects at once

  • You have strong English skills; German or any additional language is a plus

It is awesome if you also have

  • Experience in scriptwriting for tutorials, explainer videos, or social content

  • Interest in support or customer-facing roles

  • An interest in user experience, onboarding, or learning design

  • Experience with Figma is a plus

Take your chance

Be a part of shaping a fast-growing industry and make an impact from day one. You’ll have the chance to take on responsibility early, with guidance and support from experienced mentors. We foster a learning culture, collaboration on equal footing, and quick decision-making that moves things forward.

Currently, we’re proceeding only with candidates authorized to work in Germany or who already hold a Job Seeker Visa.

About us

At Bettermile, we believe delivery shouldn’t be business as usual. We’re transforming last-mile logistics to drive efficiency and create a better delivery experience for everyone.

Our geo-based, AI-powered SaaS product handles complex address processing, dynamic routing, and navigation. It is built to manage many stops and multiple constraints.

We’re setting a new standard for the last mile and pushing the industry forward, powered by a skilled, international team of tech enthusiasts, logistics experts, and a product suite designed to keep evolving.

Du hast keine Lust mehr auf einen Vertriebsjob ohne echte Perspektive – ohne Verantwortung, ohne Beteiligung, ohne klare Karrierechance?

Bei SC Ventures steigst du nicht als „Verkäufer“ ein – du übernimmst Verantwortung für messbare Umsätze und entwickelst dich zur Leitung unseres Vertriebsbereichs.

Du arbeitest im direkten Austausch mit Geschäftsführern zertifizierter Bildungsträger (AZAV) und führst sie durch unseren klar strukturierten Kauf- und Entscheidungsprozess – vom Erstgespräch bis zur langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

Du führst Gespräche, steuerst die Pipeline, identifizierst Abschlusschancen und sorgst dafür, dass keine Gelegenheit liegen bleibt.

Wenn du Ergebnisse lieferst, wirst du daran beteiligt:

Du erhältst eine leistungsbasierte Umsatzbeteiligung auf deine Neukunden – vertraglich geregelt, transparent und ohne politische Spielchen.

Wir reden nicht über Wachstum – wir setzen es um.

Über 50 Bildungsträger pro Jahr entscheiden sich für SC Ventures – weil wir nicht nur verkaufen, sondern liefern.

Wir selbst haben innerhalb von drei Jahren einen eigenen Bildungsträger mit über 50 Teammitgliedern aufgebaut – durch klare Vertriebs- und CRM-Strukturen. Genau dieses Fundament nutzen wir heute im Vertrieb unserer Beratung.

Jetzt suchen wir dich:

Eine vertriebsstarke Persönlichkeit, die abschließen kann – und mehr will als nur closen.

Aufgaben

  • Du führst strukturierte Erst- und Beratungsgespräche mit Geschäftsführern zertifizierter Bildungsträger (AZAV) – professionell, verbindlich und mit klarem Abschlussziel.
  • Du steuerst deine eigene Sales-Pipeline – vom Erstkontakt über Follow-ups bis zum Vertragsabschluss.
  • Du präsentierst unsere Workshops und Beratungsmodelle, entwickelst Angebote und führst Interessenten konsequent durch den Entscheidungsprozess.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung und den Beratern zusammen – dein Input fließt direkt in Produktentwicklung und Vertriebsprozesse ein.
  • Bei starker Performance entwickelst du dich Richtung Teamverantwortung – bis hin zur Leitung eines eigenen Vertriebsbereichs.

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B- oder B2C-Vertrieb, idealerweise im Beratungs- oder Agenturumfeld.
  • Nachweisbare Abschlusserfolge – du hast Deals geclosed, nicht nur „Gespräche geführt“.
  • Souveränes Auftreten auf Entscheider-Ebene – du kannst mit Geschäftsführern reden und sie überzeugen.
  • Klares Sales-Mindset: verbindlich, ergebnisorientiert, fokussiert auf Conversion statt Aktivität.
  • Kommunikationsstärke & Verbindlichkeit – du kannst Vertrauen aufbauen und Deals sauber zum Abschluss bringen.
  • Bonus, aber kein Muss: Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen, SaaS-Vertrieb oder beim Aufbau von Sales-Strukturen.

Benefits

  • Attraktives Fixgehalt
  • Umsatzbeteiligung ab dem ersten Abschluss – keine Wartezeit, du verdienst mit deinen Ergebnissen direkt mit.
  • Klarer Karrierepfad Richtung Vertriebsleitung (Head of Sales) – wer liefert, führt.
  • Feste Lead-Pipeline ab Tag 1 – du steigst nicht bei null ein, sondern arbeitest mit bestehenden Inbound-/Outbound-Kanälen.
  • Moderner Arbeitsplatz im Herzen Hamburgs (An der Alster) inkl. MacBook & iPhone.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung – kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen.
  • Weiterbildungsbudget und individueller Entwicklungsplan, fokussiert auf Sales Excellence & Führung.
  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung & Zugriff auf etabliertes Vertriebs- und CRM-Framework – du musst nichts neu erfinden, du optimierst und skalierst.

Wen wir wirklich suchen

Du willst gestalten, statt verwalten.
Du denkst in Lösungen, nicht in Zuständigkeiten.
Du bringst Vertriebserfahrung mit und kannst auf Augenhöhe mit Geschäftsführungen kommunizieren.

Dann bist du bei uns richtig. Wir suchen keine Mitläufer – sondern Menschen mit Drive, die Verantwortung übernehmen und Strukturen mitentwickeln wollen.
Bei SC Ventures agierst du wie ein Unternehmer im Unternehmen: mit klaren Zielen, viel Eigenverantwortung und direkter Wirkung auf die Ergebnisse unserer Kunden.

data.title: Senior Sales / Key Account Manager (m/w/d)

data.description:
Worum geht's?

Du hast bei KPMG, BCG, McKinsey, Bain oder einer vergleichbaren Beratung gelernt, wie man auf Vorstandsebene überzeugt, komplexe Transformationen strukturiert und unter Druck liefert.

Und du hast gemerkt: Die Decks werden größer, die Hierarchien länger, dein Impact auf die eigentliche Entscheidung wird kleiner. Up-or-out, 60-Stunden-Wochen für die Marke eines anderen, drei Freigabeschleifen bevor du mit dem Mandanten überhaupt sprechen darfst.

Bei SC Ventures drehen wir das um: Du übernimmst eigene Mandate bei etablierten Unternehmen mit wachsender Komplexität und sprichst direkt mit der Geschäftsführung oder dem Vorstand. Keine Pyramide dazwischen. Keine drei Partner, die sich vorher abstimmen müssen.

Was du bei einer Big4/MBB-Beratung an Struktur, Methodik und Executive-Kommunikation gelernt hast, bringst du zu uns – und wirst gleichzeitig daran beteiligt, was du aufbaust: Sobald deine Bestandskunden verlängern, bekommst du eine vertraglich geregelte Umsatzbeteiligung. Kein Bonus-Pool, keine Politik – dein Ergebnis, deine Beteiligung.

Wir sind kein Konzern. Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes Team, das im Bildungssektor bereits über 100 Träger jährlich betreut – Mandate, die von etablierten Bildungsträgern mit mehreren Standorten über wachsende Mittelständler bis hin zu Konzernmandaten reichen. Du gestaltest mit, wie dieser Bereich strukturiert wird, nicht nur, wie er ausgeführt wird.

Aufgaben

Was dich erwartet:

  • Du verantwortest eigenständig Beratungsmandate für Unternehmen mit wachsender Größe und Komplexität – von der Ansprache auf Geschäftsführungs-/Vorstandsebene bis zur Umsetzungssteuerung
  • Du entwickelst Geschäfts- und Betriebsmodelle für Vertriebs- und CRM-Transformation und verantwortest deren Umsetzung – nicht nur die Folie dazu
  • Du führst Strategie-Workshops und Steering-Committees auf C-Level-Niveau
  • Du baust gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung die methodische Basis für den Enterprise-Bereich mit auf: Angebotsstruktur, Delivery-Standards, Qualitätssicherung
  • Du bist Sparringspartner der Geschäftsführung bei der strategischen Weiterentwicklung von SC Ventures im Enterprise-Segment

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung (ab Senior Consultant / Berater-Level) bei einer Top-Strategieberatung (MBB, Big4-Consulting o. ä.) oder vergleichbarer Inhouse-Strategiefunktion
  • Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der direkten Zusammenarbeit mit Vorständen/Geschäftsführungen von Unternehmen relevanter Größenordnung
  • Fähigkeit, komplexe Transformationsprojekte eigenständig zu strukturieren und zu verantworten – ohne engmaschige Freigabeprozesse
  • Executive Presence: Du überzeugst auf Augenhöhe, ohne dich hinter einer großen Marke verstecken zu müssen
  • Unternehmerisches Denken: Du willst Verantwortung und Beteiligung, nicht nur ein Gehalt
  • Branchenkenntnis Bildungssektor/AZAV von Vorteil, aber kein Muss – die Beratungslogik zählt mehr als die Sektor-Historie

Benefits

Was du davon hast:

  • Umsatzbeteiligung auf deine Bestandskunden – vertraglich geregelt, ohne Politik
  • Direkter Zugang zur Geschäftsführung – du gestaltest den Enterprise-Bereich mit, statt ihn nur auszuführen
  • Schnelle Entscheidungswege – keine drei Freigabeschleifen zwischen dir und dem Mandanten
  • Kein Up-or-out – dein Wert bemisst sich an Ergebnissen, nicht an Politik oder Tenure
  • Attraktives Fixum plus Beteiligungsmodell
  • Eigenes Weiterbildungsbudget und klare Perspektive Richtung Partner-Modell/Teamleitung
  • Moderner Arbeitsplatz im Herzen Hamburgs, MacBook & iPhone
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Gründern statt anonymer Konzernstruktur

Wen wir wirklich suchen

Du kommst aus der Top-Beratung und willst nicht mehr für die Marke eines anderen liefern. Du willst eigene Mandate, echte Beteiligung und Entscheidungen, die auch wirklich deine sind.

Wenn du lieber baust als verwaltest und lieber mit einem kleinen Team etwas Großes aufziehst, als in einem großen Team ein kleines Rädchen zu sein – dann bist du hier richtig.

Neurawork ist eine Beratung für Operational AI in Oberbayern. Um uns herum ist eine Gruppe mit

Greenfield statt Altlasten.

Tangany, based in Munich, is a highly innovative technology company with a market-leading B2B solution for the custody of digital assets on the blockchain (e.g. cryptocurrencies & tokenized assets). Our solution is already used by more than 50 institutional customers. Tangany is regulated by the German federal financial supervisory authority, BaFin.

Using our modern API, we enable our customers to easily and securely integrate blockchain functionalities into their systems. This white-label solution reduces development costs and time, enabling fast market access and ease of use for end users. Regulatory requirements can be covered for appropriate assets via Tangany's crypto custody license if required. For our continued growth, we are looking for a Head of Growth (f/m/d) to join our team.

Your role

In this role, you own business development and lead our Sales and Marketing teams, reporting directly to our Co-CEO. You work closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance. The role is deliberately broad: you are here to build what does not exist yet, not to administer what does.

Tasks

  • Lead Sales & Key Account Management directly, plus Marketing and Business Development: set shared targets, define the handover from demand generation to pipeline, and make performance measurable.

  • Build the internal processes a growing go-to-market organisation needs, including planning, forecasting, target systems, and reporting that gives management a reliable view of pipeline, conversion, and marketing contribution.

  • Define product and pricing standards, such as price models and discount guidelines, together with our Head of Products, and ensure they are applied consistently.

  • Feed structured market signals (recurring customer needs, lost-deal reasons, unserved demand) into product innovation, prioritized with Product and the C-Level.

  • Build out stablecoins and institutional tokenization custody solutions and open up new customer segments, from market validation to a repeatable route to market.

  • Own business development: partnerships, channels, strategic accounts, and complex B2B deals with long cycles and regulated counterparties.

  • Represent Tangany at management level towards clients, partners, and the ecosystem, including at industry events.

  • Act as our thought leader on a focus topic, with Marketing supporting your visibility.

Requirements

  • 8+ years in B2B growth, business development, or commercial roles, ideally in fintech, banking infrastructure, SaaS, or digital assets.

  • 5+ years leading Sales and/or Marketing teams.

  • Track record of selling complex products in long, multi-stakeholder decision processes.

  • Experience setting B2B pricing and representing a company externally, on stage and in the media.

  • Experience in regulated environments; you see compliance as a sales argument, not an obstacle.

  • Analytical mindset that also works without clean data.

  • Enthusiasm for blockchain; knowledge of stablecoins or tokenized assets is a plus.

  • A network in banking, asset management, or crypto and experience with partner or channel models are a plus.

  • Fluent in English and German (both >C1).

Benefits

Flexibility & Work-Life-Balance

  • 30 days of vacation plus ½ day off December 24th and December 31st and additional unpaid leave if needed to recharge your battery.

  • Two weeks of extra paid vacation for new parents.

  • The flexibility to work from home or in our beautiful office in the heart of Munich.

  • Possibility to go on workation for up to 40 days per year.

  • Flexible working hours, you work when you are most productive.

Your development

  • It starts from day one: With our onboarding that is tailored to your needs, you will receive a structured onboarding plan and feedback talks within the probation period (and of course after).

  • We grow and we want you to grow with us. Learning on the job, becoming a blockchain expert, exchanging knowledge with our highly motivated, well-rehearsed team with diverse skill sets, as well as taking part in individual training - our learning culture enables you to bring you personal and professional development to the next level.

  • Regular feedback meetings: Twice a year we evaluate your career pathway and take the next steps in the right direction.

Wellbeing

  • Fun at work: A match with a colleague at our ping pong table, enjoy an after-work drink with your colleagues on our amazing rooftop terrace, take part in our team events.

We believe that motivated employees are the key to success. That's why we offer flexible, digital benefits through Hrmony to support you in your everyday life.

You'll receive a monthly budget that you can allocate to your individual needs:

  • Meal allowance: whether for groceries, restaurants, or food delivery

  • Mobility budget: e.g., for the Jobticket

  • Non-Cash Benefits: flexible use for streaming, fitness, shopping & more

If you recognize yourself in this description, apply directly here.

Für unser neues Büro in Berlin-Frohnau (Reinickendorf) suchen wir dich als Kundenberater / Kundenbetreuer für internationale Internatsaufenthalte (m/w/d). Auch Quereinsteiger sind herzlich willkommen! Wir sind Akademis Internatsberatung, eine mehrfach ausgezeichnete Bildungsagentur. Wir helfen Familien, ein passendes Internat im Ausland zu finden, und begleiten sie vom ersten Gespräch bis zur Rückkehr ihres Kindes. Dabei teilen wir ihre Vorfreude, nehmen ihre Sorgen ernst und kümmern uns um die vielen kleinen und großen Fragen unterwegs. Eine Aufgabe, die dir am Herzen liegt Unsere Familien vertrauen uns eine wichtige Entscheidung an. Deshalb suchen wir jemanden, dem gute Arbeit persönlich wichtig ist: Du möchtest Eltern und Jugendliche aufmerksam begleiten, hältst Zusagen ein und bleibst an offenen Anliegen dran. Auch bei den Details arbeitest du gewissenhaft – denn auf deine Auskünfte, Unterlagen und Absprachen sollen sich andere verlassen können. Wir wünschen uns jemanden, der die persönliche Zusammenarbeit in einem kleinen Team schätzt und selbst zu einer guten Atmosphäre beiträgt: mit Freundlichkeit, gegenseitiger Unterstützung und einem ehrlichen, respektvollen Umgang. Dafür stehen dir eine gründliche Einarbeitung und ein hilfsbereites Team zur Seite.

Aufgaben

Familien beraten und von Anfang bis Ende begleiten: Du lernst Eltern und Jugendliche kennen, berätst Interessierte zu unserem Angebot und betreust deine Familien während der Vorbereitung und des Internatsaufenthalts bis zur Rückkehr. Du hörst aufmerksam zu, gehst auf individuelle Wünsche ein und hältst von dir aus Kontakt – telefonisch und per E-Mail.

Bewerbungen, Schulbesuche und Termine organisieren: Du koordinierst Bewerbungsunterlagen, Schulbesuche und die Vorbereitung auf Aufnahmeverfahren. Du pflegst Kundendaten sorgfältig, behältst Fristen im Blick und fasst selbstständig nach, wenn Unterlagen oder Rückmeldungen fehlen. Deine Familien wissen, welche Schritte als Nächstes anstehen.

Beziehungen zu internationalen Partnerschulen pflegen: Du kommunizierst auf Englisch mit unseren Partnerschulen, klärst Fragen und stimmst Anforderungen und Abläufe ab. Dabei baust du persönliche Kontakte und eine vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit auf.

Eigene Projekte gestalten und umsetzen: Du übernimmst Projekte von der Planung bis zum Abschluss, bringst Ideen ein und verbesserst gemeinsam mit uns Abläufe. Ziele und Zuständigkeiten legen wir zusammen fest.

Profil

Du übernimmst Verantwortung: Du hältst Zusagen ein, bringst Aufgaben nach der Einarbeitung eigenständig zum Abschluss und sprichst Schwierigkeiten frühzeitig an.

Du denkst mit und packst an: Du erkennst, wo dein Beitrag gebraucht wird, unterstützt dein Team und möchtest unser kleines Unternehmen aktiv mitgestalten. Eigene Ideen bringst du ein und hilfst dabei, sie umzusetzen.

Du gehst neue Herausforderungen offen an: Du arbeitest dich engagiert in neue Themen ein, stellst gezielte Fragen und entwickelst deine Fähigkeiten weiter.

Du verbindest Sorgfalt mit Tempo: Du arbeitest konzentriert und zügig, setzt Prioritäten und behältst parallele Anliegen im Blick. Unterlagen, Daten und Termine prüfst du gewissenhaft auf Richtigkeit und Vollständigkeit. Du hältst Absprachen nachvollziehbar fest und kontrollierst deine Ergebnisse, bevor du sie weitergibst.

Du berätst mit Einfühlungsvermögen: Du telefonierst ausgesprochen gerne, hörst aufmerksam zu und stellst dich auf unterschiedliche Menschen ein. Du nimmst die Wünsche und Sorgen von Eltern und Jugendlichen ernst und kommunizierst auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen herzlich, klar und professionell.

Du arbeitest an Lösungen: Du benennst Probleme klar, überlegst, was du selbst zu ihrer Lösung beitragen kannst, und beziehst rechtzeitig die Unterstützung ein, die du brauchst.

Du bleibst respektvoll und direkt: Du sprichst Meinungsverschiedenheiten sachlich mit den Beteiligten an und trägst auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen zu einer konstruktiven Zusammenarbeit bei.

Du nutzt Feedback zur Weiterentwicklung: Du gehst offen mit eigenen Fehlern und sachlichen Rückmeldungen um, setzt berechtigte Hinweise um und gibst selbst respektvoll Feedback.

Außerdem sprichst und schreibst du sehr gut Deutsch und gut Englisch und gehst sicher mit digitalen Arbeitsmitteln um. Erfahrung in Kundenberatung, Betreuung oder Organisation ist hilfreich. Unsere Partnerschulen und die Besonderheiten der Internatsberatung lernst du während deiner Einarbeitung kennen.

Wir bieten

Persönliche Einarbeitung: Wir begleiten deinen Einstieg. Schritt für Schritt übernimmst du eigene Familien, Aufgaben und Projekte.

Ein wertschätzendes Miteinander: Direkter Austausch, gegenseitige Unterstützung und Raum für Fragen und Ideen gehören zu unserem Arbeitsalltag.

Klare Erwartungen und regelmäßige Rückmeldung: Wir vereinbaren konkrete Ziele für Betreuung, Organisation und Projekte und unterstützen deine Entwicklung.

Gestaltungsspielraum: Du kannst eigene Ideen umsetzen, Abläufe mitentwickeln und mit wachsender Erfahrung weitere Verantwortung übernehmen.

Karriere- und Gehaltsperspektiven: Wir möchten, dass du dich langfristig bei uns weiterentwickelst. Mit wachsender Kompetenz, guten Leistungen und zusätzlicher Verantwortung hast du die Möglichkeit, beruflich voranzukommen und auch dein Gehalt zu steigern. Deine nächsten Entwicklungsschritte besprechen wir gemeinsam.

Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them.

 

About the Role 🤔

Conversion is one of the three chokepoints in our revenue organisation. Customers arrive, take the demo, go through KYC, and too many stall before the first purchase, or buy once and never come back. The second purchase is where the product becomes sticky, and getting a merchant there is the hardest 60 days of their life with us.

Fixing that takes two things, and this role owns both. Reps who know the product, the pricing and the playbook cold. And a conversion funnel that is measured, scored and coached rather than hoped for.

 

Function one: enablement

Training and standards

  • Make sure every rep is up to spec and trained, and keep them there.

  • Own the theoretical onboarding of every new rep, SDR, AE and AM alike: what Nivoda sells, to whom, at what price, and how.

  • Set what "up to spec" means for each role and hold the bar.

Documentation and materials

  • Own the product material for every line of business: how it works, who it is for, pricing, take rate and best practice.

  • Keep it current. A rep should never be the last person to find out something changed.

The channel to marketing

  • Act as the link between marketing and the front line. Every campaign is known to the reps in advance, socialised at the all-hands before it lands, not discovered from a customer.

The channel to product

  • Translate the product roadmap into enablement. You do not decide the roadmap. You turn it into what to sell, to whom, and when.

  • When something ships, the reps already know what it is and how to position it.

Function two: conversion

Conversion rests on two things, and this role owns both: the call, and the KYC. A brilliant call that dies in KYC converts nothing, and a clean KYC on a badly run call never gets there.

Call scoring

  • Build the scoring rubrics with the team managers, so the standard is one both sides recognise.

  • Run transcript review and scoring at volume, using Claude to do it.

  • Send the reports out every week, to everyone.

  • Run a weekly leaderboard: the best calls, the scores, winners and losers, visible to the team.

  • Build a personalised coaching plan for every rep, written down and tracked, not delivered verbally and forgotten.

  • Coach in two directions: with the managers so they can coach their own people, and directly with reps where that is faster.

KYC

  • Own the insight generation of what is working and not on the process

  • Hold the accountability of the KYC SLAs, and call it out when they slip.

  • Map the blockers and the escalation paths, and push the fix at the cause rather than the symptom, across sales, product and marketing as needed.

  • Make sure the KYC operators know the rules, and that the rules are written.

  • Train and enable both sides of it: the reps and the operations team.

How we will measure it 💻

  • Conversion through to second purchase at 75% of each new cohort.

  • KYC above 60%, in every geography, not just on the average.

  • Rubric and call scores in place and reported weekly.

  • 80% compliance against the rubric, reached by your fourth month in the role.

What do we need from you? 💪

  • Experience in sales enablement, revenue operations or frontline sales coaching in a transactional, high-volume environment.

  • You have scored calls at volume and can show what changed as a result. Gong or equivalent.

  • You are fluent with AI tooling and would run transcript review and scoring through Claude rather than by hand.

  • You have built onboarding for reps from scratch, not just delivered someone else's deck.

  • You can coach a manager, not just a rep. You are comfortable telling a senior person their team's calls are not good enough, and then showing them how to fix it.

  • You write clearly. A large part of the value here is documentation other people can pick up and use.

  • You work across Product, Marketing and Finance without authority over any of them.

  • Hands-on. This is not a strategy seat. You will be on calls, in the CRM and in the material every week.

Nice to have ✨

  • Experience with onboarding or activation motions rather than pure new business.

  • Diamonds, jewellery, or another supply-driven marketplace.

  • A second language relevant to EMEA or North America.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

We are hiring a Clinical Trials Lead to own the commercial work that follows. You will develop Heidi’s view of the market, identify the strongest entry point, build senior relationships across the industry, secure early customers and shape a repeatable route to market. Your knowledge of clinical trials will inform and shape what Heidi builds.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who operates like a founder. You will make the calls, open the doors, write the proposal, run the meeting and stay accountable after the contract is signed. As the business proves itself, the role can grow into broader ownership of Heidi’s clinical trials business.

What you’ll do

  • Develop the market thesis. Map the clinical trials ecosystem, test the most valuable opportunities and recommend where Heidi should focus its time and capital.

  • Lead customer development. Build direct relationships with senior decision makers across sponsors, biotechnology companies, CROs, sites and health systems. Conduct the outreach yourself and turn conversations into qualified opportunities.

  • Own early commercial outcomes. Build the pipeline, secure design partners and paid programmes, and own early revenue. Define the measures that show whether the business is gaining traction.

  • Shape the proposition. Turn buyer needs into a clear commercial offer, including target customer, value proposition, pricing, packaging and proof of value.

  • Inform what Heidi builds. Bring evidence from customers and clinical trials workflows to the product lead. Help the team choose problems worth solving while the product lead retains ownership of product strategy and delivery.

  • Navigate the buying process. Understand how life sciences organisations evaluate vendors, allocate budgets, manage procurement and compliance, and move from pilot to broader deployment.

  • Build the delivery model. Work with product, engineering, clinical, legal and implementation colleagues to make early programmes successful and increasingly repeatable.

  • Create the route to scale. Determine which partnerships, channels, proof points and team capabilities are required to grow beyond founder-led selling.

  • Represent Heidi. Build Heidi’s credibility with customers, partners and industry networks through thoughtful engagement and useful domain expertise.

What you’ll need

The strongest candidates will combine deep clinical trials knowledge with a record of creating commercial value. We expect the following experience.

  • Deep experience in the clinical trials industry through a pharmaceutical or biotechnology company, CRO, trial technology business, research network or closely related organisation.

  • A strong understanding of how clinical trials are funded, sold, bought and delivered, including the incentives and constraints faced by sponsors, CROs and research sites.

  • A record of building revenue, partnerships, a business line or a company in the sector. You can show what you personally originated and how it performed.

  • Senior commercial credibility. You can open a conversation with an industry executive, diagnose the underlying business problem and move the relationship towards a concrete commitment.

  • The judgement to operate in a regulated environment while respecting Good Clinical Practice, patient consent, privacy and data integrity.

  • The independence to create structure, make decisions and produce results without an established playbook or a large supporting team.

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects.

  • You default to building over requesting.

  • You're confident in your thinking and open to being wrong. Great ideas win regardless of who surfaces them.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.

We offer comprehensive private medical and dental cover through Bupa, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a £100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a £500 home office budget, a £700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to £7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp is seeking a 2LoD Compliance Strategist to provide dedicated independent second-line assurance across Ramp UK & Irish regulated businesses.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can turn regulatory expectations into a practical, evidence-led monitoring and assurance programme.

The role sits within Ramp's Europe Compliance function and supports the Head of Compliance & MLRO - Europe. You will not own first-line operational decisions or perform routine casework. Instead, you will independently test and challenge the design and operation of financial-crime, safeguarding, payments, outsourcing, governance, and regulatory-change controls. You will make sure that findings are understood, remediated by accountable owners, and independently validated before closure.

Help shape the future of robotics in construction.

ABOUT XYZ REALITY

XYZ Reality created the world’s first and only engineering-grade augmented reality solution, purpose-built for the construction industry. Our holographic technology sits within The Atom, a smart, site-safe headset and hardhat, and is used on live projects to ensure schemes are delivered on time and on budget.

XYZ has grown to over 150 staff across the UK, US and Europe, and works with mission-critical organisations and construction companies to deliver major projects.

THE ROLE

Construction sites are some of the hardest environments for robot autonomy: they change every day and are full of clutter, obstacles and people. XYZ Reality’s robotics programme is extending our technology toward robots that can operate reliably in them, from autonomous data collection and construction progress capture through to executing construction tasks.

We’re looking for a Robotics Engineer to make that real. You’ll work hands-on with robot hardware in our London office, using a modern stack (ROS 2, NVIDIA Isaac Lab, learning-based control), and see your work tested in real construction environments, not just in simulation.

This is a hands-on, individual contributor role focused on robot software and algorithmic control, backed by a good working knowledge of robot hardware. If you have strong robotics fundamentals from an MSc, PhD or applied research group, love making systems work on real robots, and want your ideas to shape the direction of a programme, we want to hear from you.

This is an office-based role at our London site in Angel, Islington.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Integrate robots with XYZ’s software, bringing up ROS / ROS 2 interfaces, robot control, sensors, compute and data flows, and building repeatable tools for bring-up, configuration, logging and monitoring.

  • Establish reliable baseline control and develop task-specific behaviours for navigation, positioning and capture, training and tuning control policies in simulation and validating them on hardware.

  • Develop localisation-aware path planning, waypoint execution and obstacle handling, working with project and site teams to turn work plans and BIM-derived locations into robot missions.

  • Integrate capture payloads so images, pose, timing and mission status flow reliably into XYZ’s construction progress workflows, working with navigation, SLAM and perception colleagues.

  • Design test scenarios and measure mission completion, coverage, localisation quality, intervention, recovery and repeatability, improving the system through measured iterations.

  • Bring technical expertise and new ideas to the programme, comparing scripted, motion-planning and learning-based approaches and helping shape what comes next.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • MSc or PhD in Robotics, Controls, Computer Science, Mechatronics or a related discipline, or equivalent applied robotics experience. Industry experience is not required.

  • Hands-on experience building, programming or directly controlling a physical robot, from an academic project, research lab or industry.

  • Strong Python and C++, practical ROS experience (ideally ROS 2) and working knowledge of kinematics, coordinate frames, feedback control, state estimation, path planning and robot hardware.

  • Experience training or tuning robot control policies (e.g. reinforcement or imitation learning) using NVIDIA Isaac Lab / Isaac Sim or similar tools, with a rigorous experimental approach.

  • The right to work in the UK. We’re unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

KEY EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

  • ROS / ROS 2, Python & C++

  • Robot control, kinematics, state estimation & path planning

  • NVIDIA Isaac Lab / Isaac Sim, reinforcement or imitation learning

  • Sim-to-real transfer on physical hardware (desirable)

  • Navigation, SLAM, perception & sensor fusion (desirable)

  • Mobile or field robotics, BIM/CAD or construction technology (desirable)

About Magentic

At Magentic, we're building the next generation of AI agents to transform how the world's largest companies manage procurement and supply chains.

We're tackling a $3 trillion market, building AI systems that can autonomously manage complex procurement workflows and help make global manufacturing supply chains more resilient.

Backed by Sequoia and Felicis, we've brought together an exceptional team with experience from OpenAI, Meta, Revolut, NASA and McKinsey.

We're growing quickly, solving challenging problems and building something with the potential to change how critical industries operate. It's an exciting time to join, early enough to make an huge impact and help shape what comes next.

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced Operations Lead to play a key role in shaping how Magentic operates as we grow.

This is the perfect opportunity for someone who is proactive, independent and comfortable taking ownership and making decisions. You'll be pragmatic and commercially minded, with a focus on delivering real impact rather than overcomplicating things. You'll thrive in a fast-paced startup environment, know how to balance competing priorities and be confident finding solutions that work for the business as we grow.

It’s a wide ranging, highly collaborative role that will interact with the whole business: you'll work across people operations, IT and tooling, legal and compliance, alongside leading projects that improve how we work across the business.

What You'll Do

  • Take ownership of key People Operations processes, helping create a great employee experience as we grow.

  • Shape how we use internal systems and tooling, finding smarter ways to work and opportunities to introduce automation.

  • Take ownership of legal and compliance operations, working with external advisers to ensure we're set up for success as we scale.

  • Drive high-impact projects, working closely with teams across the business to evolve our ways of working as we scale.

  • Build and introduce new processes that make a genuine difference to how we operate, bringing together people, tools and data to support our growth.

What We're Looking For

  • 5–6+ years' experience in Operations or a similar generalist role, including experience leading on one of the key areas (people operations, legal, compliance or IT).

  • Experience in high-growth startups is a must.

  • A whizz AI, tooling and automation.

  • Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Compensation and Benefits

At Magentic, we recognise and reward the talent that drives our success. We offer:

  • Competitive Equity: play a real part in Magentic’s upside.

  • Salary: £100,000 - £110,000 per annum

  • Private healthcare

  • Hybrid London HQ (4 days in the office).

  • Company provided meals at the office

  • Monthly “Social budget” to spend getting to know your colleagues (coffee, food, activities, etc.)

  • Work from anywhere 4 weeks out of the year

  • Salary sacrifice pension and nursery schemes

  • Annual team retreat—a fully-funded off-site to recharge, bond, and build.

Our Interview Process

We can move quickly through these stages, so let us know if you have any timelines we need to meet.

  1. Initial call (30 mins): this first step is an opportunity for you to hear more about Magentic and the role, and for us to learn more about how your experience aligns with the role.

  2. Skills interview (45 mins): in this step, we'll ask you to prepare a presentation and take Q&A.

  3. In-person interview (half-day, paid): for the final step, we invite you to come meet the team in-person. We find this is the best way for candidates to get a sense of what working at Magentic is like. This day will include a culture interview, founder interview and a presentation task / discussion with the team.

Equal Opportunities and Accommodations Statement

At Magentic, our mission is to build AI that helps solve some of the world's most complex real world problems. We believe building a diverse workforce will be the key to solving this for our customers.

 

Magentic is committed to creating a truly inclusive team and we’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. As we grow, we're intentional about building teams with a broad range of backgrounds, experiences and viewpoints, recognising that this leads to better ideas, stronger collaboration and better outcomes for our customers therefore we strongly encourage applications from all backgrounds and cultures to apply.

 

We recognise that some groups remain underrepresented within the industry and are committed to creating an environment that celebrates and supports everyone.

 

Everyone works differently, and we want to ensure our interview process gives you the best chance to show us what you can do. If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let us know and we'll work with you to make the process accessible.

 

Responsible AI Statement

At Magentic, we are committed to developing artificial intelligence that benefits humanity. We push the limits of AI's capabilities and are dedicated to its responsible and safe deployment. Recognising the profound impact of AI, we ensure that its development is centred around human needs and safety, incorporating a wide array of perspectives to fulfil our mission.

As a Production Support Engineer II at Marqeta, you will play a pivotal role in our commitment to customer satisfaction and the seamless operation of our products and services. 

You will serve as the first line of contact for our customers, adeptly handling and resolving complex technical issues while translating technical jargon into user-friendly language. Your broad knowledge base across various technologies will be instrumental in addressing a wide range of problems. In addition, you will collaborate with our Engineering teams to manage software updates and bug fixes. 

Your role will also involve becoming an expert in all areas of Marqeta's products and services and ensuring that our customers can fully utilise our offerings. As a customer advocate, you will ensure that our customers' needs and concerns are heard and addressed in our product development and service delivery processes. At Marqeta, we value the essential role our Production Support Engineers play in our service delivery chain and look forward to welcoming you to our team.

We work Flexible First. This role can be performed remotely within the UK or from our London office. We’d love for you to join us!

The Impact You’ll Have

  • Provide on-call support for rotations and escalations

Metaview is an AI company focused on recruiting. We build AI agents that help world-class companies hire with radically more speed and precision. We automate the toil, and augment the human for companies like Brex, Affirm, Deel, and Navan.

Founded by Siadhal and Shahriar after their experiences scaling Uber and Palantir, we’ve raised $110m from top-tier investors including Google Ventures and Insight Partners.

It’s still day 0: Now is the time to re-engineer how work gets done with AI at the core, and our toughest challenges still lie ahead. We’re looking for people seeking the hardest, most fulfilling work of their lives.

How we work

Four principles guide us:

  • Velocity. Optimize for rate of learning. Take action, get feedback, get better.

  • Hospitality. Sweat the experience. Delight customers, candidates and colleagues, even when it’s inconvenient.

  • Transparency. Public unless private. Share context openly within the company so people and agents can take initiative.

  • End-to-end. Deliver outcomes, not tasks. Step beyond your job description and see the work through.

The role

As a Sales Ops Analyst, you’ll be a foundational operational partner to our EMEA sales and customer success teams. You’ll keep the go-to-market engine moving—resolving systems issues, delivering the data and insights needed to make decisions, and removing the day-to-day blockers that slow our customer facing teams down. In doing so, you’ll help build the infrastructure, processes, and operating rhythm that allow our EMEA go-to-market motion to scale with speed and precision.

Key ownership areas:

  • Troubleshoot and resolve GTM systems issues for EMEA sales and customer success teams during UK business hours.

  • Handle data requests and reporting for go-to-market stakeholders, including sales and engagement leadership.

  • Establish and manage deal desk processes, oversee deal flow, and give sales reps the operational support they need.

  • Build dashboarding and business intelligence infrastructure using a BI tool rather than relying solely on Salesforce dashboards or manual Google Sheets reporting.

  • Manage Chargebee access and provide billing system support, reducing the need for sales reps to work directly in Chargebee and lowering the risk of errors.

  • Create scalable processes for recurring data requests, systems troubleshooting, and cross-time-zone handoffs.

  • Document and continuously improve go-to-market operations workflows.

Early priorities:

  • Establish documented, repeatable deal desk workflows with clear handoff procedures.

  • Implement dashboarding infrastructure that enables deeper insights and reduces reliance on manual reporting.

  • Create reliable systems for resolving recurring data requests and operational issues.

What you bring

  • Strong sales operations acumen, including familiarity with sales operations, deal desk workflows, revenue systems, and the full sales funnel.

  • The ability to identify operational bottlenecks, diagnose their root causes, and design scalable systems and processes.

  • Technical fluency with business tools such as Salesforce, Chargebee, BI tools such as Hex, and data platforms.

  • Comfort moving between systems, understanding data flows, and implementing operational solutions without heavy engineering support.

  • The ability to translate business questions into useful reporting, dashboards, and clear operational recommendations.

  • High ownership and autonomy, with sound judgment about when to solve independently and when to escalate.

  • A proactive approach to supporting sales and customer success teams, anticipating needs before they become blockers.

  • Clear communication, strong attention to detail, and comfort operating in a fast-moving environment.

What we offer

  • The best co-workers you’ll ever have, in an environment that fosters cohesion, collaboration, and performance.

  • Supreme rate-of-learning as we re-orient how the world works with AI.

  • High compensation, through cash and equity.

  • All the benefits you’d expect and more.

GumGum is The Mindset Company™ transforming advertising. We're an advertising technology company delivering results by matching brands with people in the right mindset in the moments that matter. Our platform is powered by the Mindset Graph™, our AI-driven data engine that processes billions of real-time contextual, creative, environmental, and historical signals to match every ad with the most receptive audience. The result is advertising that drives meaningful outcomes for advertisers and publishers, and is more relevant for consumers.

We were founded in 2008 and are headquartered in Santa Monica, California, operating in over 19 markets across North America, Europe, Japan, and Australia.

Our principles guide our work every day and are as follows:

  • Customer-Obsessed: We're focused on advertising solutions that solve needs and drive success for clients and partners.
  • Make it Happen: We have a bias for action and take ownership to deliver results.
  • Always Innovate: We push boundaries with creativity and technology.
  • Foster Belonging: We ensure colleagues feel included, supported, and empowered to thrive.

To be a part of The Mindset Company™ transforming advertising, please visit www.gumgum.com/careers.

Based in Manchester, the Digital Director, Regional UK is an autonomous individual contributor responsible for prospecting, negotiating, and closing advertising sales across the North of England. Reporting to the Regional Sales Lead and supported by a cross-functional pre-sales team, the role focuses on managing a large book of business, developing strategic relationships within large and mid-sized agencies, and upselling GumGum's product portfolio. The Director leverages deep digital media expertise to independently solve complex client challenges, translate client feedback into internal product insights, and drive consistent regional revenue growth.

What You'll Achieve

  • Drive regional UK revenue by managing a book of business and closing new business across large and mid-sized agencies in the North of England.
  • Generate a high volume of prospecting activity, including cold outreach, pitch presentations, RFPs, and tailored sales solutions.
  • Upsell existing brand and agency clients on both established and new GumGum advertising products.
  • Cultivate and expand strategic relationships across client-direct brands, media agency contacts, and holding company teams.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Account Managers, Client Strategists, and pre-sales teams to ensure sold proposals are executed accurately.
  • Translate market and client insights back to internal product teams to help refine and adapt platform offerings.
  • Exercise independent judgment and discretion to solve client challenges and select optimal ad solutions with minimal managerial oversight.

Skills You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of digital advertising sales experience with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding targets.
  • Demonstrated experience managing a large book of business, backed by an established network of regional brand and agency contacts.
  • Solid understanding of the digital media and advertising landscape; programmatic background preferred.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce for activity tracking, client logging, and pipeline reporting.
  • Working proficiency in Google Suite, Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word.
  • Strong presentation, relationship-building, and interpersonal communication skills across all client hierarchy levels.
  • Self-motivated, highly proactive, and extraverted approach with an eagerness to entertain clients and adapt to evolving strategies.

What We Offer

  • Learn about our benefits & perks package at gumgum.com/benefits. If you'd like additional information, your recruiter can share more specifics during the hiring process!
  • Note: This position offers the opportunity for remote work or 'work from home' as there isn't a nearby office.

Awards

  • 2025 AdExchanger Awards AI Innovators, Technology & Service Provider, Finalist

We're always learning and evolving as a company, and we continue to take thoughtful steps to support our people and strengthen our culture.

About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Team

Our Infrastructure teams build the foundation that engineers at Wolt, Deliveroo, and DoorDash build on: the compute, cloud, and networking capabilities that enable Engineering teams to develop, deploy, and run services at global scale. The EU Compute team has a specific focus on provisioning, scaling, and the efficient operation of GPU infrastructure for AI and ML workloads. This is an emerging space with plenty of greenfield opportunities.

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to be a hands-on technical leader for this infrastructure work that crosses team and brand boundaries. You'll set direction for the platform, turn complex problems into deliverable plans, write and review production code, and help other engineers make sound decisions. It's an exciting time to join: we're building a global platform and the choices made now will shape how engineers across the company ship for years.

What you'll be doing

You'll own some of the hardest infrastructure problems in the company and make the platform easier to operate and safer to build on. We're determined to build great platform products and user experiences, and you'll be pivotal in making this reality.

Day-to-day in this role you'll:

  • Set technical direction for shared AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure, balancing reliability, security, developer experience, and cost.
  • Lead substantial initiatives from design through rollout and operation, coordinating dependencies and decisions across Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash, focusing on workloads targeting GPUs.
  • Evolve Kubernetes clusters, cloud networking, identity, and infrastructure provisioning to support growing and varied workloads.
  • Build reusable Terraform patterns and self-service tooling that help teams provision infrastructure safely and consistently.
  • Improve deployment and operational practices, including GitOps, observability, capacity planning, incident response and recovery.
  • Use production signals and developer feedback to find platform friction, choose where to invest and measure whether changes actually help.
  • Assist with supporting the platform, with deep focus on GPU infrastructure, as well as broad focus on compute in general.
  • Gracefully sunset legacy infrastructure and tooling, and create strategies to reduce toil.
  • Mentor engineers through design reviews, implementation and incidents, raising the quality of infrastructure work across teams.

Our humble expectations

  • Deep experience building and operating Kubernetes and AWS infrastructure in production. Familiarity with GPU workloads and orchestration is a plus.
  • Strong software engineering skills: you use Go, Python or a similar language to build maintainable tools and automation.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (we use Terraform) and with designing systems that other engineering teams depend on.
  • A track record of leading complex technical work across teams, including architectural decisions, delivery, and operational follow-through. You have the breadth to collaborate and design across team and domain boundaries, and the depth to have hands-on impact.
  • Strong judgment on trade-offs in distributed systems, networking, security, reliability, and cloud cost.
  • Clear communication, and the ability to bring people together around a practical technical direction.

What we offer

  • Scope and influence. Shape infrastructure used globally, while staying close to the engineering. Your work will help product teams ship services with greater ease and confidence.
  • Real problems at global scale. Multi-cluster Kubernetes, AI / ML workloads, cloud networking, GitOps, and progressive delivery across a global company.
  • Autonomy and ownership. Set direction and see it through from design to operation, with the backing of a global engineering organisation spanning Europe and the US.
  • Growth. Room to expand your scope, whether through deeper technical leadership or broader cross-domain influence.
  • Great people. Work with talented engineers and leaders in a diverse, international environment, mentoring and learning from others.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .
