Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person.

We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform.

This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch.

We are now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one.

This role will be based in London, UK as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin.

What you'll do:

  • Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers.
  • Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout.
  • Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times.
  • Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer.
  • Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. We build on their signals rather than rebuild them, so clean interfaces matter.
  • Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decisions as we establish the fraud infrastructure baseline for financial products, with support from senior engineers on the team.
  • Write well-tested, observable code and help the team hold a high quality bar. In fraud, a silent failure is a loss event.

Our expectations:

  • 3 to 6 years of professional software engineering experience, including backend services you have shipped and owned in production.
  • 1+ years of production experience in Golang, or strong experience in another backend language and real enthusiasm for picking Go up quickly.
  • A working understanding of low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems. Real-time decisioning comes with a latency budget, and you are keen to learn to build inside one.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, and some exposure to event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar).
  • Willingness to operate what you build, including a share of on-call, with a pragmatic approach to reliability.
  • Uses AI tooling in day-to-day development and can critically evaluate its output for correctness and quality.

Nice to have

  • Experience in fraud, risk, payments, lending, or financial crime, especially money movement fraud, bank account linking fraud, payout abuse, or lending fraud.
  • Experience with rules engines, real-time feature stores, or ML model serving in a decisioning path.
  • Background in Kotlin, Java, Python, or Node.js alongside Go.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP).
  • Experience working across multiple brands, regions, or regulatory regimes.

What we value

  • A product-oriented mindset. You think beyond the ticket, understand the "why" behind the work, and take a high level of responsibility for outcomes rather than output.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. This is a new team on a new surface; parts of the charter are still being drawn, and you will help draw them.
  • A track record of owning a project or feature end to end, especially in fast-paced environments.
  • Clear and proactive communication, with a collaborative spirit. We work across three companies and several time zones, so we move fast, but we succeed together.
  • An adversarial instinct. The best fraud engineers enjoy thinking like the attacker.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Compliance team’s mission is to keep iwoca a safe and trusted lender for UK small businesses, and to make the compliant path the easy path for the teams we work with.

We make sure iwoca meets its regulatory obligations, particularly the financial crime, sanctions and data protection requirements that apply across our suite of products and services.

We are the second line of defence for the UK business. We advise the people building and running the business on what the rules require, set the policies and standards they work to, and test whether what happens in practice matches them. We work alongside the product teams so that each product meets its obligations and can grow.

Data protection is central to what we do. We hold the data privacy function for the UK business and own how iwoca handles personal data end to end: the lawful basis for how customer, applicant and third-party data is used; data subject access requests and other individual rights; personal data breaches; retention and deletion; records of processing; marketing and consent; the privacy review of new products and features; and the governance of automated decisioning and AI tooling.


How we work:

  • We enable rather than block. The answer is rarely just “no” — it’s what it would take to get to yes, and what the firm is accepting if it goes ahead anyway.

  • We go to the source. Positions are grounded in the actual rule, regulation or guidance, and we can show where they come from.

  • We’re proportionate. Controls match the risk in front of us. We don’t build process for its own sake.

  • We’re close to the business. We work directly with Tech, Data, Credit, Operations and Legal, and we want to be in the room early rather than at the end.

The role

As Data Privacy Analyst you will run iwoca’s day-to-day UK data protection work and help the business apply UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018 and PECR in practice. Your primary focus will be the statutory core: data subject access requests, data protection impact assessments, legitimate interests assessments, personal data breaches and records of processing.

The role is not only to run that work but to improve it. A significant part of the job is identifying where our privacy operations could be automated, supported by AI or otherwise improved, assessing what each option would take and what it would mean for compliance, and specifying it well enough for our Tech and Data teams to deliver.

There is real room for the role to grow: as you build credibility, so does the scope, towards owning areas of the framework outright, leading on AI and automation governance, and taking a larger advisory remit across the business.

You will report to the Data Privacy Manager and work closely with the Head of Compliance who also acts as iwoca’s DPO, so you will have experienced support on the harder judgement calls. This is a hands-on role and the work is visible — much of it goes to senior stakeholders or to the regulator.

Impact and influence

  • Individual rights and data breaches. Own data subject access requests from intake to response — scoping the search, applying exemptions and meeting the statutory deadline — along with erasure, rectification and objection requests. Triage and investigate suspected personal data breaches, assess them against the 72-hour notification test, and keep the breach register accurate.

  • Privacy assessments and advice. Assist with DPIAs, legitimate interests assessments and other privacy reviews on new products, features, suppliers and data flows. Be an accessible first point of contact for teams across iwoca with a data protection question, and give them an answer they can act on, early enough to shape what they build.

  • Records, policies and reporting. Keep the record of processing activities accurate as the business changes, hold the retention and deletion schedules to account, review data processing agreements with suppliers, help maintain our data protection policies and standards, and produce the privacy reporting that goes to senior stakeholders.

  • AI and automated decisioning. Help assess AI tooling and automated decision-making across lending and operations: what personal data goes in, what lawful basis supports it, what the model does with it, and what rights customers have over the outcome. That includes the risks specific to these systems — decisions taken without meaningful human involvement, bias in outcomes, unreliable model output — and recommending how we address them.

  • Automation and improvement. Identify the manual steps in our privacy operations that should not be manual, assess the options, and set out the requirements and compliance implications clearly enough for Tech and Data to deliver them.

The requirements

Essential skills

  • Experience. Experience in data protection or privacy operations, or in a compliance, legal, risk or operational role where data protection was a real part of the job.

  • Data protection knowledge. A solid practical understanding of UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018 and PECR, and of how the ICO expects firms to apply them. Familiarity with the changes made by the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 is an advantage.

  • Privacy operations and assessments. Hands-on experience of statutory work: DSARs, DPIAs, legitimate interests assessments, breach handling, ROPA maintenance or data processing agreement review. You may not have done all of these — but we want to see that you have done some of them properly.

  • AI and automation. A real interest in, and working understanding of, how data protection law applies to AI and automated decision-making. Enough technical fluency to see where a manual process could be automated, set out what is needed, and hold your own in a conversation with engineers.

  • Stakeholder management: Comfortable dealing directly with product, engineering, marketing, credit and operations teams, and able to give a non-specialist a clear answer they can act on rather than a legal summary.

Bonus:

  • Sector experience. Financial services or fintech, ideally in lending or payments.

  • Credentials. A privacy or AI qualification such as CIPP/E, CIPM, or ICO-recognised practitioner certificates — or working towards one.

  • Practical tooling. Experience using Claude Code, LLMs or privacy management platforms.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our award-winning Data Science team at a pivotal moment. Carwow operates a two-sided marketplace — connecting car buyers and sellers at scale — and data science sits at the heart of how we make that marketplace smarter, faster, and more valuable for everyone in it. In fact, we recently won GenAI initiative of the Year at the British Data Awards.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role working centrally across the business. You'll partner with teams spanning Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering and Operations — developing and deploying ML and AI solutions that drive outcomes across both sides of our marketplace. The problems you'll work on are genuinely varied: pricing models, propensity and demand signals that sharpen marketing spend, personalised recommendations for our web product and CRM, and LLM-powered solutions for operational challenges like document verification.

You'll translate ambiguous business problems into structured, production-ready solutions — and you'll be expected to deliver them end-to-end, from first principles through to being deployment-ready and beyond.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • End-to-End ML & AI Delivery: Lead data science initiatives from problem framing through to deployment, monitoring, and iteration — delivering the full production lifecycle. With no dedicated ML engineering function, you'll be responsible for ensuring your solutions are robust, scalable, and performing in the real world long after they ship.

  • GenAI & LLM Application: Design and build LLM-powered solutions where they create genuine business value — document processing, intelligent search, content understanding, and beyond. Apply them alongside classical ML with clear judgement about where each approach earns its place.

  • Commercial Impact: Connect your work directly to business outcomes. Whether you're building a model to improve marketing efficiency, a pricing signal to sharpen commercial decisions, or a recommendation engine to increase conversion — you understand the business lever you're pulling and design your solutions accordingly.

  • Prototyping & Experimentation: Move fast to test ideas before committing to full-scale development. Define rigorous success metrics upfront, validate honestly, and know when to double down and when to walk away.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering and Operations stakeholders to understand problems deeply before reaching for a solution. Translate findings into clear, actionable narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Standards & Craft: Contribute to shared best practices, documentation, and ways of working that raise the bar for the data science function — and help more junior team members grow alongside you. Drive continued adoption of AI capabilities to drive efficiencies, automation and constantly leverage new capabilities.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

Please note: We know that no candidate will be the perfect match for all we've listed in this posting, so we’d encourage you to apply if you feel you're close to the brief but not an exact match. Ideally you’ll have

  • Commercial Mindset: You think about business impact first. You understand how your models connect to revenue, efficiency, or customer outcomes — and you use that to prioritise, scope, and communicate your work.

  • Stakeholder Partnership: Proven ability to work with commercial, marketing, and product stakeholders — translating business problems into well-scoped solutions and communicating technical solutions, challenges and outcomes clearly at all levels.

  • Sound Judgement: You navigate the tooling landscape with clear eyes — knowing when classical ML is right, when GenAI unlocks something new, and when a simpler solution is the more honest answer. Strong instincts for scalability, reliability, and explainability.

  • [Bonus] Marketplace or Two-Sided Platform Experience: Understanding of supply/demand dynamics and how data science creates leverage in a marketplace context.

TEHCNICAL SKILLSET

  • Proven ML Experience: A strong track record of building, deploying, and maintaining ML models in Python in a production environment — not just notebooks. You've owned models after they ship and know how to keep them healthy.

  • Full-Lifecycle Delivery (MLOps): Comfortable delivering the end-to-end production lifecycle — model training, versioning, monitoring, and champion/challenger experimentation — without relying on a dedicated ML engineering team to carry that responsibility.

  • GenAI & LLM Expertise: Hands-on experience building LLM-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. You understand how to apply, evaluate, and extend these tools — and you're honest about where they fall short.

  • Technical Depth: Solid experience in a cloud ML environment with software engineering principles — version control, code reviews, unit testing, and familiarity with containerisation.

  • Quantitative Rigour: Strong foundation in statistical evaluation and experiment design. You can define and defend success metrics, and you know when a model is degrading and what to do about it.

  • [Bonus] Experience with VertexAI

TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES

  • Languages: Python, SQL

  • Data & Transformation: dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery

  • Visualisation & BI: Looker

  • Engineering & MLOps: Docker, GitHub

  • Workflow & Orchestration: Vertex AI Pipelines (GCP), Kubeflow

  • LLMs & GenAI: Gemini API, Claude API

ABOUT LIVESTORM

Livestorm is the world's leading end-to-end video engagement platform. Founded in 2016, Livestorm allows companies to organize powerful online meetings, webinars and virtual events from end-to-end. Our web-browser platform provides teams with all the workflows around video engagement to promote, host and analyze online events. Livestorm is built with ease of use in mind. We serve companies of all sizes, from startups to Fortune 500s. Brands like Shopify, Honda, Spendesk, Front and Revolut trust Livestorm for premium video engagement during their online events.


Here are our core values:

  • Stay curious: Be interested in the world around you.

  • Remain humble: Keep learning and keep your ego in check.

  • Be resourceful: Go that extra mile in the most efficient way.

  • Own it: Take pride in what you do, own your wins, and fails.

  • Be transparent: Sharing knowledge, learnings, feedback, and mistakes.


MISSION

Livestorm sales team is a team of entrepreneurial and driven sales professionals. They are playing a key role in the expansion of Livestorm as we establish ourselves as a market leader in the video communication market, leveraging Livestorm's existing customer references, marketing programs, turning leads into long-lasting partnerships.


Account Executives are responsible for identifying, segmenting, engaging, and converting qualified Mid-Market and Enterprise prospects into paying customers according to an annual quota.


You will report to the Head of New Business, and will closely collaborate with all our teams (Marketing, Sales, Customer Care, Product and Finance) to drive maximum value and success with new Livestorm customers.


A successful Account Executive will be a skilled communicator and presenter who can find the best fit between client and product.


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

  • Qualify inbound marketing source leads (MQLs) coming from Mid-Market & Enterprise prospects and turn them, if qualified, into opportunities and closed contracts

  • Focus your outbound efforts on the Enterprise segment (with a focus on the Finance, Healthcare & Tech industries) and develop / execute sales strategies and tactics to generate pipeline, drive sales opportunities and deliver repeatable and predictable bookings

  • Work on the NEMEA (Nordics & UK) and US market (native speakers are preferred for this role / previous sales experience in these regions is a big plus).

  • Use of a variety of channels to identify new prospects and close new deals such as social media, internet, web-based tools & outbound calling

  • Manage effectively all CRM activity relating to your accounts (Salesforce) and all the tech stack of an AE at Livestorm (SalesNav, Salesloft, Modjo, Chili Piper, Notion & more)

  • Pro-actively work with other teams (Account Management, Growth & Marketing, Customer Success, etc.)

  • Provide clients’ feedback, especially on product, in order for Livestorm to adjust and prioritize its product roadmap.


At Livestorm, we believe that diversity's got talent! We are committed to building an inclusive company culture in which a diverse mix of talented people will feel proud to join and engage. Our goal is to ensure that every Stormie feels valued and has the opportunity to thrive. Ready to apply? We are ready to meet you! All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


JOB REQUIREMENTS 

  • Experienced: You have extensive experience (+3 years minimum) of successfully selling Software/SaaS license agreements into Enterprise / Large accounts in France and abroad across a variety of industries (expertise in the Finance & Healthcare industries is a plus)

  • Industry Knowledge: A good understanding of selling video communication platform would be ideal however, a background in selling SaaS and closing 6/7 figure deals is more important

  • Overachiever: You have consistently achieved and/or exceeded your sales goals across your geographic territory and have a track record in closing 6/7 figure contracts - You are results oriented

  • Outbound Mindset: You have a desire, even an obsession, to identify new prospects, contacts and decision makers to expand the number of new logos

  • Excellent Communication: You know what to say (both internally and with clients) and more importantly, how to say it in both French and English

  • Collaborator: You know that selling is a team sport and will partner with virtual teams to ensure success. You have experience in working with remote teams and clients to close joint business

  • Go-Getter: Willing to go the extra mile with a strong work ethic - disciplined and resourceful.


Moreover, we are looking for someone based in Paris (to meet prospects, go on events and be close to your management) but working remotely anywhere in France is permitted.


Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. So however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

At Lucis, we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the OS for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives. You can read more about who we are and how we work here.

Health is complex, personal, and deeply important to our members. As the voice of Lucis clients, you support them throughout their health journey and own member happiness end to end.

With rapid member growth, we are hiring our first dedicated Customer Care Team Lead. You will own the member experience end-to-end, stabilize our operational metrics, and build and manage a world-class support team.

  • Frontline Excellence: Personally resolve member and lab partner inquiries via chat and phone, delivering high-touch support from day one.

  • Internal Product Mastery: Act as our expert power user, testing our internal OS and advocating for tool improvements that boost operational efficiency.

  • NPS & Proactive Care: Design proactive care initiatives to ensure member satisfaction remains consistently best-in-class.

Post-Ramp: Team Scale & Process

  • Team Scaling & Playbooks: Build, mentor, and lead a growing support team while writing our core SOPs, escalation pathways, and training guides.

  • Cross-Functional Feedback: Turn daily support interactions into structured insights that directly inform product roadmap decisions.

 

About you

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger.

 

You’ll fit in well if

  • Experience: 2+ years in high-volume B2C customer care or support, with a track record of mentoring peers and a readiness to step into your first formal lead role.

About Customs Support Group

Customs Support Group (CSG) is the European market leader in customs services, operating across 15 countries. CSG is owned by private equity and a fast-growing, dynamic, data-driven company, dedicated to expanding its presence through strong organic growth and strategic acquisitions. Its key priorities include digital transformation, operational excellence and customer experience, all aimed at driving growth and enhancing efficiency.

The Role

You will take our AI stack and lead its development and customisation for the market.

This is a builder and do-er role. You will design, test and implement practical and compliant agentic AI solutions on top of foundation models document understanding, classification support, retrieval over our own procedures and tariff material, and agents that carry multi-step operational work end to end.

You are not being asked to train models from scratch. You are being asked to make models that already exist behave reliably enough that operations staff trust them with customs declarations, where being wrong has consequences.

Working closely with Operations, Transformation, IT and Group teams, you will turn business needs into scalable solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and customise AI solutions for the market, from prototype through to production ownership.

• Be curious and prepared to self-learn to use generative-AI to build agents that make a difference to our business

• Identify automation and decision-support opportunities across customs and business processes, and size them honestly before building.

• Design solutions using generative AI and large language models — retrieval, tool calling, structured extraction from customs documentation, and agentic workflows where they genuinely fit.

• Own the evaluation. Define how we know a solution is working before it ships, and how we know a change has not made it worse. This is treated as core to the role, not an afterthought.

• Manage pilots and implementation, and set the criteria for killing a pilot as clearly as the criteria for scaling it.

• Monitor performance, inference cost, latency and business impact.

• Collaborate with local teams, Group functions and technology partners.

• Contribute to privacy, security and AI governance compliance, working with Group Legal and IT Security. You should understand how the EU AI Act applies to what you build, and be able to produce the documentation that goes with it.

.

Requirements

Essential

• 1-2 years AI engineering, software engineering or intelligent automation, including LLM or AI features that real users depended on.

• Strong Python and SQL, with production code ownership. Not familiarity.

• Demonstrable experience integrating large language models into production systems — prompt and context design, retrieval-augmented generation, structured output, and handling failure gracefully.

• Practical experience with at least one major cloud AI platform (Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex).

• Solid full stack backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, testing, CI/CD. Most of this job is

• Strong communication skills — you will spend real time with operations staff who are experts in customs and not in AI.

• Professional fluency in English.

Desirable

• Evaluation engineering: building eval harnesses and regression suites for non-deterministic systems, LLM-as-judge approaches, and human-in-the-loop review design. This is the single strongest signal we look for and we will weight it heavily.

• Context engineering: designing and version-controlling what a model sees — retrieval strategy, memory, tool descriptions, and policy layers that constrain what an agent is allowed to do.

• Agent orchestration frameworks and standards (LangGraph, MCP, Temporal or equivalent), and experience with long-running or multi-step agent workflows.

• Observability and cost control for inference at volume.

What success looks like in your first year

• By month three: You understand our customs processes well enough to challenge what we ask for, and you have shipped one small, useful thing.

• By month six: At least one AI solution is live, measured against a baseline, and demonstrably better than what it replaced.

• By month twelve: There is a working evaluation process others can use, a ranked pipeline of next opportunities, and at least two colleagues outside IT operating what you have built without you in the room.

What We Offer

• A key role in shaping AI capabilities.

• The opportunity to build solutions with direct business impact, on real operational volume rather than pilots that never leave the lab.

• An international and fast-evolving environment, with peers in other Customs Support Group markets working on the same problems.

• Professional growth opportunities, including a budget for conferences, certification and model/compute costs for your own experiments.

• Permanent role. Hybrid working.

How to apply

Send us your CV and a short note a few paragraphs is plenty describing one system you have put in front of real users. We are most interested in what went wrong with it and what you did about that.

At Parallel, we build AI agents to help healthcare facilities automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding.


Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams.

We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption.

Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients.

We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started.

 

The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it !

The role

At Parallel, we work with a team of 25+ freelance TIMs (medical information technicians) on different tasks, in particular retrieving medical documents from our partner facilities’ software. This is a core part of Parallel. With fast, secure access to our partner facilities’ data, we code the first hospital stays within a few days and prove Parallel’s ROI. Then we automate document extraction so we can scale.

As Ops Associate, you support the Ops team on managing freelancers and on cross-functional Ops projects. You take ownership of critical operational topics end to end and contribute directly to Parallel’s growth. You work daily with our Head of Ops, the Deployment Strategists, Customer Care and our freelance TIMs.

You’re in charge of staffing and managing our network of freelance TIMs and become their main point of contact, working directly with our Head of Ops. You also work on cross-functional projects that structure Ops as Parallel scales. It’s a chance to see first-hand how a generative AI solution is deployed in hospitals, and to experience a startup’s scale-up from the inside.

What you’ll do

Staffing and management of freelance TIMs

You’re responsible for the network of freelance TIMs who support our clients. You make sure the right person is on the right assignment, at the right time, within a compliant framework.

  • Sourcing and recruiting: identify, qualify and recruit new TIMs based on needs (specialties, facilities, volume).

  • Staffing assignments: assign TIMs to client accounts, anticipate workload peaks and manage priorities.

  • Onboarding: train new TIMs on the Parallel tool and our ways of working.

  • Monitoring: centralize assignment tracking and manage the team’s performance.

  • Contracts and compliance: keep freelance contracts up to date, in line with our ISO 27001 and HDS requirements (data access, confidentiality).

Cross-functional Ops projects

You support the Ops team on cross-functional projects to make processes more robust and scalable. For example, you could:

  • Compliance and security: contribute to the ISO 27001 and HDS certification project on the Ops side (registers, evidence, access reviews, contracts).

  • Processes and documentation: keep client training notes up to date and improve internal playbooks (deployment, support).

Who we’re looking for

  • You’re looking for your first permanent job, or possibly an end-of-studies internship (with the goal of staying with us on a permanent contract).

  • You’re rigorous: you organize yourself, prioritize, and follow your topics through to the end.

  • You have strong people skills: you can adapt to profiles very different from yours, explain technical topics and bring a team along.

  • You’re comfortable in a tech environment and like understanding how software works so you can help others use it.

  • You’re autonomous: when you’re given an assignment, you figure out how to set up the right processes and resources to get it done.

Why join us?

  • Real impact: our agents free hospital teams from administrative work.

  • A central role: you work with Ops, Product, Tech and the field teams.

  • Room to grow: we’re hiring for this role to help someone grow with us over time.

  • The right time: Series A closed, product already used by ~100 hospitals, a fast-growing team.

  • The package: Alan health insurance, Swile, Apple equipment, 50% of transport covered, a team event every month and two off-sites a year.

  • Our offices: Paris 2nd arrondissement, boulevard de Sébastopol.

The process

  1. Call with Léa, Talent Lead (30 min)

  2. Call with Clémentine, Head of Ops and your future manager (30 min)

  3. Case study with Clémentine and Jules and meeting with Paul, CEO

  4. Offer

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

About Payflows

At Payflows, we build software that helps large companies manage and automate their payment workflows. It’s not the flashiest part of a business, but it’s one of the most critical: invoices, approvals, payments, and controls. When these things slow down, the whole company feels it.

But our ambition goes further than just building a better workflow tool.

We believe the future of finance operations is not faster clicking: it’s no clicking at all 🫳 🎤

Finance teams shouldn’t spend their days moving data from one screen to another. Software should do the operational work, and humans should focus on reviewing, approving, and making the decisions that matter.

That’s the direction we’re building toward: an agent-driven finance platform, where intelligent agents handle the repetitive tasks, and users stay in control.

We started in 2022 with a small team and a rough first version of the product. Three years later, we’re working with major companies across France, the UK, and the US while choosing to keep our team small and human-sized.

We moved fast, shipped a lot, and not everything was built in a perfect way. But it helped us learn quickly, sign real customers, and prove that the problem we’re solving truly matters.

In 2024, investors trusted us with a $25M Series A. That gives us the chance to keep growing while also strengthening our foundations and building the system that will power this agent-driven future.

Today, we’re about 35 people from many different countries, and we’re looking for a few amazing humans to join the next chapter. 🤗

🚀 What you’ll actually do

You’ll help build a product that real finance teams rely on every day.

For us, engineering is not just about clean code, it’s about reliability, clarity, and trust, especially when money and automation are involved.

In a typical week, you might:

  • Design and implement new services for a product feature.

  • Refactor an early service to make it more robust.

  • Investigate a performance or production issue.

  • Work with product and frontend to shape a new feature.

  • Review code and help teammates improve.

  • Build backend tools that our AI agents use to perform real finance operations.

  • Design safe, deterministic workflows where agents propose actions and humans review them.

Your time will be split between building new features and improving what already exists. Both matter.

You won’t just build endpoints. You’ll help shape the execution layer that our agents rely on: the APIs, data models, and workflows that let them act safely in production.

You’ll work closely with product, frontend, and customer-facing teams. We expect engineers to take ownership of parts of the system and help make them more reliable over time.

💻 Our current tech reality

Our stack evolves based on our challenges, but we care more about good design than trendy tools 🙏

Python is our core language. It helps us move fast, keep the code readable, and fits naturally with our AI-driven approach. A growing part of the system is built around agents that use our backend as a set of reliable, deterministic tools.

  • Core language: Python

  • Backend: FastAPI + Pydantic

  • Data: PostgreSQL

  • Infra: AWS, serverless when it makes sense

  • Performance: some Rust for critical paths

  • Architecture: multi-service backend, simple enough to reason about

Some parts of the system are clean and well-tested. Others were built quickly and need love. That’s the phase we’re in.

Over the next year, we’ll focus on:

  • Turning core workflows into reliable tools for our agents

  • Simplifying services

  • Improving tests and observability

  • Making performance more predictable

  • Cleaning up early code

We know we’re not perfect, but we care a lot about improving step by step.


✨ Who’s going to thrive with us

You’ll probably feel comfortable here if:

  • You like building products people actually use.

  • You are autonomous and take ownership of what you ship.

  • You take initiative and lead by example.

  • You’re curious and enjoy figuring things out.

  • You’re pragmatic about trade-offs.

  • You communicate with kindness and clarity.

This role is a great fit if you’re excited by the idea of:

  • Building systems that are used by AI agents, not just humans.

  • Designing reliable, safe automation in production.

  • Working on a product that is still early and evolving quickly.

You don’t need to know everything about AI. But you should be curious about it and excited to work in a system where agents are part of the core product 🤖

🧩 What you’ll get from this role

  • Real ownership over parts of the system.

  • Direct impact on customers and product decisions.

  • A small, human team where your work is visible and meaningful 🤝

  • A mix of feature work, system design, and technical improvements.

  • Exposure to real scaling and production challenges.

  • The chance to help build an agent-driven product from the inside.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity.

  • Flexible remote setup (we prefer people to come into Paris or London office twice per week. At a minimum we’d ask you to be at an office 3 days per month, onboard in Paris for your first few weeks, and work CEST timezone).

  • A high-autonomy environment where you have real ownership and space to make an impact.

  • Plenty of room to grow, take responsibility, and shape parts of the product.

  • A culture based on trust, ownership, and clear communication.

This isn’t a huge corporate environment. In exchange, you get autonomy, responsibility, and the chance to shape a product that’s still early in its story—and help build what finance operations will look like in the next decade 🚀

Notre activité Strategy accompagne les dirigeants et investisseurs dans la résolution de problématiques complexes. Sa valeur ajoutée est de proposer des solutions réalistes et quantifiées, en combinant des approches stratégiques et opérationnelles. Afin d’accompagner sa forte croissance, nous recherchons actuellement des Senior Consultants et Consultantes (3 à 5 ans d’expérience professionnelle hors stage). L’activité Strategy compte aujourd’hui plus de 150 collaborateurs en Europe, issus des cabinets de conseils ou des entreprises.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Rejoindre l’équipe Strategy c’est prendre part à l’aventure entrepreneuriale du cabinet, en ayant un rôle essentiel dans le développement de l’activité. Pour maximiser notre impact chez les clients, nous adoptons des cycles de travail courts grâce à des sprints successifs. Cela favorise la rotation des équipes et accélère l'apprentissage. De plus, un programme de formation complet et un mentorat assuré par des collaborateurs(trices) plus expérimenté(e)s, permet à nos consultant(e)s de développer et approfondir rapidement les compétences du métier. Notre large portefeuille de clients vous permettra également de découvrir de nombreux secteurs d’activité et des contextes d’entreprises variés.

En nous rejoignant vous interviendrez principalement dans les contextes d’intervention suivants :

‘Deal Strategy & Exécution’ : Dans le cadre d’une transaction, en préparation ('pre-deal’) ou en exécution (‘post-deal’), vous accompagnerez des vendeurs comme des acheteurs durant tout le processus.

En préparation du deal :

  • Définition de l’Equity Story (rationnel de l’opération et stratégie de développement)

  • Réalisation de due diligence stratégique, commerciale, opérationnelle et ESG

  • Evaluation des potentielles synergies issues d’un rapprochement

  • Plan de séparation (‘Carve-out’)

Lors de l’exécution du deal :

  • Préparation de plan d’intégration (‘PMI’) et définition de la stratégie et des actions nécessaires pour garantir la continuité de l’activité ('Day 1 readiness’)

  • Mise en œuvre de plan de synergies

  • Animation et pilotage de la performance

‘Corporate Strategy & Business transformation’ : Vous participerez à la construction et à la mise en œuvre de plans stratégiques et de programmes de transformation, avec notamment :

  • Construction de plans stratégiques : plan de transformation, plan de création de valeur, repositionnement stratégique, définition de solutions et offres innovantes

  • Conception de programmes d’excellence commerciale et de développement du revenu, de nouveaux business models, de plan marketing, de plan de performance des ventes et d’amélioration de la relation client

  • Définition de nouveaux business models et innovation, de plan marketing, de plan de performance des ventes et d’amélioration de la relation client

  • Conception de projets d’excellence opérationnelle d’amélioration des performances (manufacturing, supply chain, etc.)

  • Conception de programmes de transformation digitale ou technologique

  • Mise en place des feuilles de route d’un Business Plan

  • Accompagnement des entreprises dans leurs enjeux liés aux sujets ESG

‘Turnaround & Operational Restructuring’ : Dans des contextes de sous-performance ou de crise, vous participerez à la construction et mise en œuvre de plans de retournement, avec notamment :

  • Construction et mise en œuvre de plans de retournement, avec si nécessaire la rationalisation de l'empreinte industrielle et des réseaux de distribution, la refonte de l’organisation et l’optimisation du Besoin en Fonds de Roulement

  • Mise en place et pilotage de cellules dédiées (« CRO Office ») avec notamment la construction de plans stratégiques dans des contextes de sous-performance,

  • Reprise en main de filiales ou d'activités déficitaires

En tant que Senior Consultant(e), vous serez le/la référent(e) d’un ou plusieurs chantiers sur vos missions. Vous vous verrez confier la responsabilité de l’avancement des analyses et des rapports. Vous serrez en contact direct avec vos clients dans le cadre des ateliers et des comités de pilotage. Votre rôle portera également sur l’accompagnement des équipes avec lesquelles vous serez amené(e) à intervenir.


Nous recherchons pour ces missions des candidats de formation supérieure (Bac+5 –école d’ingénieur ou école de commerce), ayant acquis 3 à 5 ans d’expérience parmi les suivantes :

  • Une expérience dans le conseil en stratégie ou au sein d’une équipe stratégie en entreprise

  • Une expérience dans le conseil durant laquelle il/elle aura développé de solides compétences opérationnelles (Supply Chain, achats, contrôle de gestion industriel, Manufacturing, logistique, excellence commerciale) avec une appétence pour l’analyse des impacts financiers

  • Une expérience opérationnelle en entreprise dans une structure reconnue pour son excellence dans les domaines opérationnels et / ou financiers

Vous êtes doté(e) de qualités relationnelles et analytiques reconnues. Curieux(se), dynamique, vous faites preuve d'esprit d'équipe et vous pratiquez couramment l’anglais dans le cadre de vos missions (la pratique d’une seconde langue étrangère serait un plus). Vous êtes motivé(e) par le challenge d’intervenir dans des contextes à forts enjeux stratégiques marqués par des enjeux marchés ou de retournement ainsi que d’élargir vos compétences sur les dimensions financières et opérationnelles. Vous avez envie de vivre une aventure entrepreneuriale en participant à la forte croissance de Eight Advisory.

data.description:
Senior Stack Scientist

About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy.

As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks.

  • Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles.

  • Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance.

  • Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams.

  • Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies.

  • Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production.

  • Translate results into clear requirements for flow fields, bipolar plates, MEAs, sealing and compression.

  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers, and present results to internal stakeholders and partners.

Skills and Experience Required

  • PhD or MSc in electrochemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field.

  • 12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred).

  • Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management, reactant distribution, contact resistance and compression.

  • Hands-on experience with stack test benches, cell voltage monitoring, EIS and durability/AST protocols.

  • Solid understanding of MEA, GDL and bipolar plate degradation mechanisms.

  • Experience with modelling and data analysis tools (e.g. Python, MATLAB, COMSOL or similar).

  • Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Team player who can also work autonomously in a fast-moving environment.

  • Management experience

  • English is mandatory; French or German is a plus.

Start date: Immediately

About Wallee Group AG

Wallee Group is a leader in advanced payment solutions, dedicated to providing robust, scalable, and secure systems across multiple domains. We enhance customer experiences through innovative payment and finance technology that empowers businesses to grow efficiently. With operations spanning several countries, we thrive on collaboration and agility, utilizing the Scrum framework to drive our international teams. At Wallee, we stay at the forefront of market trends, continuously innovating to deliver premier services to our global customers.

The Role

The Product Line Manager owns the full lifecycle of a product line - from introduction through to controlled end-of-life. The role combines strategic portfolio and roadmap management with subject matter expertise in specific verticals, bringing market, product, and supplier perspectives into one consistent strategy.

In Wallee's payment technology context, this specifically includes managing hardware/firmware generations (e.g., terminal models, certification versions like the EMV L2 kernel) and forward-looking planning for successor products.

The Impact You’ll Make

  • Drive Full Lifecycle & Strategy: Own the product journey from concept to decommissioning—defining launch criteria, target segments, success metrics, and forward-looking successor products before hardware/firmware generation changes.

  • Optimize the Portfolio: Maintain a structured view of all variants (terminal types, SoftPOS vs. hardware POS) using frameworks like the BCG matrix to prioritize investment and avoid overlap/cannibalization.

  • Build Capacity-Synced Roadmaps: Translate strategic goals and vertical needs into prioritized, time-boxed feature roadmaps (e.g., quarterly or PI planning in SAFe), balancing "run the business" compliance updates against "grow the business" initiatives.

  • Champion Vertical Expertise & Research: Act as the "translator" between vertical requirements (e.g., retail, hospitality, events) and engineering's technical language while running ongoing trend scanning (PCI/EMV updates), competitor analysis, and customer feedback synthesis.

  • Lead Go-to-Market & Sales Enablement: Define launch plans (positioning, pricing, training, documentation), coordinate alignment across Sales, Marketing, and Support, and assist Sales with technical expertise on complex, regulated deals.

  • Manage Suppliers & Ecosystems: Onboard and manage external partners (terminal manufacturers, component suppliers, certification labs), overseeing SLAs, operational forecasting, defect escalations, contract negotiations, and risk mitigation (such as dual-sourcing).

What Success Looks Like

  • Strategic Portfolio Health: A clear, non-overlapping product line where investments are prioritized effectively and End-of-Sale (EOS) / End-of-Life (EOL) migration paths are seamlessly executed.

  • Uncompromising Compliance: Continuous alignment with certification and regulatory standards (PCI, EMV, ep2) across the entire portfolio, eliminating compliance risk.

  • Reliable Supplier Alignment: High-performing partner relationships with well-managed SLAs, aligned roadmaps, and secure supply chains.

  • Market-Driven Innovation: Roadmaps and GTM materials that accurately reflect vertical user journeys, market trends, and validated customer needs.

  • Cross-Functional Readiness: Seamless coordination with internal teams so all departments are aligned and fully enabled from day one of product launches.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Product Experience: Proven experience in product management, ideally with portfolio or product line ownership in fintech, payments, or hardware-enabled software.

  • Domain Knowledge: Understanding or familiarity with payment certification and compliance topics (PCI, EMV, ep2) is a strong plus.

  • Vertical & Market Expertise: Experience or strong interest in specific industry verticals, coupled with a track record in market research and competitor analysis.

  • Strategic & Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with a solution- and customer-oriented approach.

  • Stakeholder & Supplier Management: Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, comfortable managing both internal stakeholders and external supplier relationships.

  • Languages: Fluent in English and German.

Why Join Wallee?

  • Modern Workspace: A beautiful office in the heart of Winterthur - comfortable, bright, and collaboration-ready.

  • True Flexibility: Flexible daily hours and a 4-week "Work from Anywhere" policy every year.

  • Innovation First: We work with the latest tech stacks in a flat hierarchy where your voice actually matters.

  • Growth & Culture: Competitive compensation, aligned with experience, seniority, and expertise, personal development budgets, and a social calendar filled with events.

  • The Perks: Fresh fruits, snacks, and high-quality coffee to keep you fueled.

Don’t tick every box? Neither do most great hires. If the role feels right, reach out, we’d love to see if we’re a match.

data.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity 

We are looking for a Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer to join our Motion Intelligence team. You should bring deep expertise in reinforcement learning and policy optimisation, grounded in real-world robotics experience, and be excited to push the boundaries of autonomous robots. We are looking for someone who can provide senior-level RL and learning-based control guidance across the team — shaping how we train, deploy, and maintain learned policies on physical robots operating in demanding industrial environments.
Beyond RL expertise, we value engineers who take pride in writing clean, maintainable code, simplifying complex systems through thoughtful design, and championing sound interfaces and architecture.

At ANYbotics, we develop tailored software solutions that enable our legged robots to execute inspection and maintenance tasks with precision and consistency. This role sits at the intersection of cutting-edge RL research and production robotics — from sim-to-real policy transfer and reward engineering through to reliable deployment on mission-critical systems in the field. You’ll work across the full lifecycle — from early development prototyping through to mission‑critical, production deployments.

 
The Market & Our Technology 

ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach. Our customers are large asset operators and industrial service providers pioneering the use of robotics technology for inspection and maintenance. Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LIDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality and consistent inspection results. We develop numerous customised hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and all related ANYbotics electrical hardware.


Your Impact
  • Lead the design, training, and deployment of reinforcement learning policies for robot motion — bridging the gap from simulation to reliable real-world performance
  • Provide senior technical guidance on RL and learning-based control across the team, mentoring engineers and establishing best practices for policy development workflows
  • Own and evolve the RL training infrastructure and sim-to-real pipeline, ensuring reproducibility, scalability, and fast iteration cycles
  • Shape the technical vision for internal ML tooling and experiment management (e.g. training dashboards, automated evaluation pipelines), driving efficiency and rigour across the team's learning workflows
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders to identify how to expand the robot's autonomous operational envelope
  • Triage field issues related to locomotion, recognise failure patterns, and rapidly improve policy robustness based on real deployment data
  • Write, deploy, and maintain efficient Python and C++ software for the learning and locomotion stack

    • Your Profile
  • PhD in robotics, machine learning, computer science or a related field with a strong focus on reinforcement learning; alternatively, an equivalent track record of RL research and deployment in robotics Or
  • Master's degree from a top-tier technical university (e.g. ETH Zurich, EPFL) in robotics, machine learning, computer science or related field and 5+ years of professional experience
  • Proven track record of shipping ML models to the field and maintaining those solutions over time
  • Solid grounding in robot control fundamentals and autonomous systems, including: motion control, state estimation, path planning and actuation
  • Experience using robotic simulation tools such as Gazebo or Isaac Sim
  • Strong understanding of sim-to-real transfer, domain randomisation, reward shaping, and policy robustness techniques
  • Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch); working knowledge of C++
  • Strong knowledge of Linux systems and middleware frameworks for integrating learned components into a larger software stack
  • Pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset — comfortable balancing research exploration with production delivery
  • Excellent communication skills in English

    • Bonus Points
  • Experience training and deploying RL policies on physical robots — not just in simulation
  • Development of scalable and modular robot architectures of motion control systems
  • Experience with navigation systems and autonomous mobile robot operation in unstructured environments
  • Interest in agentic engineering toolchains
  • Experience leading software architecture design and software engineering best practices
  • A solid grasp of physical systems, specifically multibody dynamics, electromechanical drive physics, energy optimization, and contact physics, to ensure learned policies respect hardware limits and transfer successfully from simulation to the real world
    • We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.
     
     
    Agency Policy: We are not currently partnering with external search firms or recruitment agencies. Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring.

We turn every customer interaction into an opportunity. We connect conversations, customer data and payments with AI Agents so that companies can deliver personal customer journeys at scale: both online and in person.

“The entire customer journey. One platform”

What we value

Every CM.com colleague, connects to our 4 shared values:

Drive and Lead

You take initiative, make decisions and recognize opportunities. Making mistakes is part of moving forward.

Grow and Learn

The growth of our colleagues and our customers is our priority. You like to experiment, learn continuously and actively share knowledge and insights with others.

Together and Care

We work together and we believe that diverse perspectives lead to stronger outcomes. You value the social side of work, you show genuine interest and care about one another’s well-being.

Speed and Change

By welcoming AI Agents into our organisation, we fundamentally change how work is done. You are comfortable with change and you love working in a high paced environment.

The Role

As a Full Stack Developer in the Onboarding & Enablement team, you'll own the front door of CM.com connectivity: the self service experience where customers sign up and start messaging in minutes, without a sales call or a single email. It is one of the most important topics at CM.com today, and your team is the conductor behind it.

In today's tech market, speed wins. Customers choose the provider they can start with right now, and they value ease over a long list of requirements. Think of how quickly you can take out a phone subscription: that is the experience we want to offer. Our customers are people, but increasingly also AI agents, and neither wants to wait for a callback.

Behind that one simple interface sits a complex platform. Every channel works differently. For example: WhatsApp runs via Meta, RCS via Google and Orange, and more channels and suppliers are joining. Customers should never notice any of that. The complexity is ours, not theirs.

You will

  • Build the self service onboarding experience that takes customers from sign up to their first message in minutes

  • Turn every customer request into the right configuration across our own systems and external suppliers, fully automated

  • Make it easy to plug in new channels and supplier partnerships, so the platform grows without adding complexity for the customer

  • Drive automation across the full customer journey, for people and AI agents alike

  • Own your work from idea to production, including how it runs on our infrastructure

  • Use AI tools actively to improve your own work: experiment, automate, and share what works with your team


  • Medior to senior full stack developer with hands on experience in both front end and back end

  • Strong in Angular on the front end, and in C# and .NET on the back end

  • Solid knowledge of relational databases, such as SQL Server or PostgreSQL

  • Fluent in English and Dutch

  • Nice to have: experience with DevOps or system engineering, as the team also manages its own infrastructure

  • Genuinely curious about AI: you experiment with tools like ChatGPT or Copilot and you're open to working differently as they improve

Believe you’d be a great fit for this role, even if you don’t tick every box? Reach out to our Recruitment team! We’d be happy to connect and see if we can make it work together.

What we offer

As a CM.com club member, you’ll have the following benefits:

  • Onboarding: Join our unique 3-days Global Onboarding program in our Headquarters in Breda, a deep dive into the culture of CM.com.

  • Healthy food: Daily healthy lunches and snacks to keep you energized.

  • Effortless commute: The Shuttle mobility card, commuting allowance and Lease-a-bike options get you where you need to be. We have CM company cars that you can use for client visits as well.

  • Invest in your future: A solid pension plan.

  • Time off: Recharge with 25 vacation days, plus the option to purchase 10 additional days.

  • Own your success: Become a shareholder with our Employee Share Purchase Program.

  • Your Development: We support your growth and development through initiatives like the CM Academy, Udemy courses, exclusive meetups with thought leaders, the Young Professional Program, and our own CM Business Adventure (CMBA), ensuring you’re always learning and evolving

  • Vitality: Our Vitality Team organizes a year-round vitality program to support a healthy body and mind for all colleagues. Think of stress prevention workshops, ergonomist visit, weekly bootcamps, yoga sessions and our CM sports day.

  • Together at CM.com: Weekly drinks, board game nights, karaoke throwdowns, yearly ski trip, and more! We have something for everyone.

Our diverse perspectives fuel innovation and drive us forward. We welcome everyone, regardless of age, background, or beliefs.

Before you apply

We work on-site, move fast, and expect you to bring your own thinking. Priorities shift, AI is actively changing how we work and we embrace that reality. If that sounds like a great environment to you, we'd love to hear from you.

Note: For this position, we can only consider candidates who already hold a permanent work and residence permit for the Netherlands.

Ben jij een Software Engineer die graag zelfstandig bouwt aan slimme, schaalbare software? Wil je technische uitdagingen oplossen, meedenken over nieuwe functionaliteiten en jezelf blijven ontwikkelen binnen een ervaren productteam? Dan is deze functie bij BAS World iets voor jou!

  • Je onderzoekt en verhelpt incidenten en denkt mee over structurele oplossingen;

  • Je signaleert technische verbeterkansen en experimenteert met nieuwe technologieën en moderne engineeringtools.

Je krijgt de vrijheid om zelfstandig aan oplossingen te werken, maar staat er nooit alleen voor. Je leert van ervaren collega's, deelt jouw eigen kennis en werkt samen aan producten die dagelijks wereldwijd worden gebruikt.

Wat maakt deze functie zo interessant?

Bij BAS World werk je niet alleen aan technische oplossingen, maar denk je ook mee over de ontwikkeling van onze digitale producten. Je krijgt de ruimte om kritische vragen te stellen, ideeën te testen en invloed uit te oefenen op technische keuzes.

Je werkt in een productgedreven organisatie waar we continu zoeken naar manieren om onze software slimmer, sneller en betrouwbaarder te maken.

Of je nu nieuwe functionaliteiten ontwikkelt, bestaande systemen verbetert of experimenteert met AI en cloud-native technologie: je krijgt volop mogelijkheden om jezelf technisch verder te ontwikkelen en steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid te nemen.

Jouw specificaties

We zoeken een Software Engineer die zelfstandig kan werken, graag technische uitdagingen aangaat en verder kijkt dan alleen het schrijven van code.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je hebt ervaring als Software Engineer en kunt zelfstandig nieuwe functionaliteiten en technische oplossingen ontwikkelen;

  • Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werk, van het ontwerp tot een betrouwbare werking in productie;

  • Je schrijft leesbare, testbare en onderhoudbare code;

  • Je denkt mee over technische keuzes en weet jouw ideeën en oplossingen duidelijk uit te leggen;

  • Je werkt graag samen met collega's, staat open voor feedback en deelt actief jouw kennis;

Daarnaast heb je ervaring met meerdere van de volgende technologieën en werkwijzen:

Je hoeft niet overal expert in te zijn. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je een goede technische basis hebt, zelfstandig kunt werken en gemotiveerd bent om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

Wil jij bouwen aan digitale producten die wereldwijd worden gebruikt en jezelf verder ontwikkelen als Software Engineer? Solliciteer dan direct en ontdek jouw mogelijkheden bij BAS World!

BAS is een internationaal familiebedrijf dat sinds 1962 actief is in de automotive-sector. Met meer dan 1.000 collega's zijn we wereldwijd actief in de handel en het onderhoud van vrachtwagens, trekkers, trailers, bouwmachines, bedrijfswagens en landbouwmachines.

Binnen BAS World werken onze Product- en Tech-teams dagelijks aan de ontwikkeling en verbetering van onze digitale producten. We werken productgedreven en volgens agile principes, waarbij we nieuwe ideeën onderzoeken, testen en ontwikkelen om zo snel mogelijk waarde toe te voegen voor onze gebruikers.

Bij BAS houden we van aanpakken, samenwerken en kansen benutten. Brabantse nuchterheid, passie, teamwork en ondernemerschap vormen de basis van onze organisatie. Samen blijven we groeien en onze digitale dienstverlening verbeteren!

data.description:
The mission
Help build fair, engaged and high-performing teams.
We believe everyone deserves a fair opportunity to develop and be rewarded for the value they bring. That’s why we build software that helps organizations set clear expectations, define what a role entails, assess performance fairly, support employee growth, and make compensation transparent and explainable. From clear roles to fair rewards, all within one continuous process. Will you join us in driving this change?

Please note: for this role, it’s important that you already live in the Netherlands and are able to work from our Utrecht office at least three days a week.

The opportunity
As our new Web & Mobile Full Stack Developer, you’ll help build and improve our SaaS platform across all surfaces: mobile, web and backend. You’ll work on our React Native mobile app as we scale it into a fully independent experience for mobile-first markets. You’ll contribute just as actively to our web platform, from intuitive user interfaces in React to scalable APIs and backend services in Node.js.

Your average week in Utrecht:

  • Building and shipping new features in our React Native mobile app (around 50% of your time)

  • Building and shipping new features on our web platform, with React on the frontend and Node.js on the backend (around 50% of your time)

  • Shaping features together with product and design to improve the user experience

  • Working in structured weekly sprints with your team

  • Writing clean, scalable and maintainable code in TypeScript, React, React Native, Node.js and MongoDB

  • Building and improving performant, secure REST APIs

  • Contributing to technical discussions and architecture decisions, including our mobile strategy

  • Reviewing pull requests to keep quality high

  • Improving developer workflows, CI/CD and automated testing

  • Owning features from idea to deployment, across mobile and web

In short: your work directly makes our platform faster, smarter and more scalable, helping our customers grow and pushing Learned to the next level 🌱

The team
You’ll join a development team of 6 developers in Utrecht, working closely with 11 colleagues in Sri Lanka through a buddy system that keeps lines short. The team is led by Alex, our CTO. We’re an international company of 55 people (7+ nationalities) serving 350+ customers, increasingly at enterprise level. With the EU Pay Transparency Directive coming up, demand for our product is growing fast, and so is our roadmap.

Your growth

  • Learning every day from experienced, senior colleagues across mobile, web and backend

  • Hands-on experience building AI features into a product used by hundreds of companies

  • A personal development budget of €1,000 per year

  • An open feedback culture: we practice what we preach


The musts

  • You already live in the Netherlands and can work from our Utrecht office at least 3 days a week

  • Around 3+ years of experience as a Full Stack Developer

  • At least 1 year of experience building production apps in React Native

  • Solid experience with TypeScript, React and Node.js (or comparable stacks), including REST APIs

  • Experience building or integrating AI features in a product (e.g. LLM features, agents or retrieval)

  • You enjoy switching between mobile, frontend and backend, and owning features end-to-end

  • You communicate clearly and confidently in English

  • You’re proactive, take ownership and love learning together through feedback


The nice-to-haves

  • Experience with MongoDB or similar databases

  • Experience with CI/CD, automated testing and cloud infrastructure

  • Experience publishing apps to the App Store and Google Play

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, ideally HR tech

The benefits

  • A salary between €4,000 and €5,500 gross per month (based on 40 hours, depending on experience), with room to grow

  • 25 vacation days (based on full-time)

  • A pension plan (10%, of which we pay 50%)

  • A personal development budget of €1,000 per year (based on full-time)

  • A MacBook Pro and everything you need to do your job well

  • Travel expense reimbursement via our mobility plan

  • A hybrid setup: at least 3 days at the office, flexible beyond that
